That brat was only at the crystalline core realm. How on earth could he have so much power?
He didn’t have time to think about it, being forced to defend himself once again while Qingyi used the second form of the Stormy Monarch Sword Art.
A blade of Qi formed in the air and exploded towards the patriarch, cutting through everything in front of him.
This time, he was barely able to defend himself.
His right hand broke along with some ribs as his body was sent backwards again, passing through several concrete structures until he hit the wall surrounding the Lei family villa.
He tried to swallow a healing pill, but Qingyi obviously wouldn’t allow it, appearing in front of him as he used the third form of his technique.
"Long Qingyi, remember that name while you burn in the depths of hell."

sentences.text: After leaving Feiyan to take care of the pills, Qingyi began to imbue the girls with bloodlines.
Luckily, rare-grade bloodlines were considerably cheap, at least compared to their power and the ease with which they could be obtained.

The hardest part was defining the best lineage for each one, although almost all of them only wanted draconic lineages, especially because of Khaedryss, who became the girls’ new pampering target after little Yao left the world of the mind.
After talking to Ruxue and the system and spending a few hours studying an almost endless list, Qingyi finally found a lineage and constitution suitable for all of them.
[Name: Blood of the Nine Thunder Celestial Dragon
Description: The blood of an ancient mythical beast that carried within it part of the nine thunders of the celestial tribulation, each thunder more powerful than the last.
Grade: Rare
Price: 5,000 lust points]
[Name: Celestial Dragon Body Constitution
Description: The constitution of a celestial dragon, powerful and resistant.
Grade: Rare
Price: 5,000 lust points]
They weren’t the best he could get, obviously, but they were good enough and, according to the system, they had a great affinity with all the girls.
Qingyi spent another almost two weeks imbuing that bloodline and constitution into each of the girls.
When he had finally finished, Feiyan had already partially mastered the recipe for making those pills and had even made a few.
Qingyi wondered if they would work on him, but the system’s words convinced him to stay away from it.
The pills would actually work, but they would result in his body exploding in a very painful death.
In the end, he just instructed Feiyan to focus first on her own lineage and spiritual root, especially since it was linked to alchemy.
Naturally, raising this to mortal grade would result in making pills more quickly and using fewer resources.

After a bit more fun with the girls, he finally returned to the real world, leaving his cultivation room and soon coming face to face with the sight of a cold, silver-haired beauty sleeping on his sofa.
He approached her, placing a small kiss on her lips before smiling and spending a few lust points to buy advancement materials.
She had already made a lot of progress and was now just one step away from the crystalline core realm.
Even considering that she had a high-level spirit root, such a breakthrough speed was still absurd.
"What do you say we deal with some pigs today?" Qingyi asked as Qingxue opened her eyes, revealing a shy smile in front of his penetrating gaze.
"Y-yes... but can we first...?" She looked away, her face blushing deeply.
It didn’t take Qingyi long to understand what she wanted and he quickly grabbed her soft breasts as he placed himself between her legs.
A bit of fun with his beloved former master wouldn’t hurt, right?
It was a rainy night at the Lei family residence, which was just under half a week’s journey from the Eternal River Sect.
In the great central hall of the patriarch’s palace, adorned with golden walls and a throne that seemed to be made of pure gold, stood several important figures.
Most of them at the peak of the crystalline core realm, with five of them at the nascent soul realm.
They were all the most powerful cultivators in the Lei family.
"I’ve given you a mission, to fetch a stubborn bitch and hand her over to me... what’s so difficult about that?" The patriarch of the Lei family roared, his face filled with anger and regret.
He had agreed with the woman’s father to allow her to remain in the outer region as a way of getting to know the world before being demoted to just another rich man’s wife.
But if he had known that taking her would be so problematic, he would have brought her in immediately.
"I beg your pardon, patriarch, but we didn’t imagine she’d be this talented and we’re still investigating what happened to the great elder and the young lord."
"Fuck them, bring me that woman, do what’s necessary.
Kidnap her, drug her, whatever, I want to see her here, sucking my cock!" The patriarch stood up, grabbed a bottle of liquor and drank it in a single gulp.
He was about to go to his chambers when his whole body froze,
He turned around quickly, a sword appearing in his hands.
In the next moment, the entire palace shattered as a thunderous slash tore through the wood and destroyed the protective formations.
The poor bastards who hadn’t managed to defend themselves in time were cut in half, desperate screams echoing around the place.
"Who dares!" The patriarch spat out a gulp of blood as his body rose into the air, his eyes full of murderous intent focused on a couple flying a few meters above his residence.
"You!..." The patriarch growled, recognizing the woman with silver hair and transcendental beauty.
"Do you want to get rid of him yourself?" Qingyi asked Qingxue, but the silver-haired beauty just shook her head.
She could sense that her husband wanted to do this much more than she did.
" Good, deal with those who are running away and avoid hurting the servants.
I’ll teach that disgusting pig not to mess with what’s mine." Qingyi spoke, the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword gleaming in his hands.
"Brat, what do you think you’re doing next to my wife?" The patriarch’s words died in his throat as Qingyi closed the distance between them in the blink of an eye.
"Yours?" Qingyi asked, his voice cold and deadly as he thrust his sword, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch’s Sword Art.

"Long Qingyi, remember that name while you burn in the depths of hell."

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - Mind World seed
paragraphs: Soon after dealing with the Lei family, Qingyi and Qingxue left, using the flames of Khaedryss to erase the clues that they had been there.
Not that he was too worried.
There were thousands of families like the Lei and, although such extermination was brutal, it wasn’t exactly uncommon in the Nine Peaks Basin.
As long as they weren’t discovered, any crime was allowed.
They both flew back to the sect with a lighter heart.
On arriving at their residences, they were immediately greeted by the sight of an enormous tiger cutting through the skies, its flaming eyes focused on them both.
"Junior Long Qingyi greets the guardian!" Qingyi exclaimed as he bowed, drawing a laugh from Yanxiao.
"No need for so much formality, kid. I see you’ve both advanced to the crystalline core realm, congratulations." Yanxiao spoke, unable to hide the shock on his face.
Such speed of advancement was in no way inferior to that of the founder of the Eternal River Sect, who had transcended to the immortal heaven.
He really felt as if, for the first time in many thousands of years, he would finally see geniuses capable of defying the heavens and overcoming the tribulation to the immortal heaven.
"The guardian praises us too much," Qingyi replied humbly, but was unable to stop himself from raising a doubtful eyebrow.
"You must be wondering what I want with you, fair enough." The guardian turned around.
"Get on your beast and follow me, you wouldn’t be able to keep up with me with your own flying ability." He spoke, focusing his gaze on Qingxue. "You too."
Qingyi shuddered softly at those words.
Yanxiao knew about Khaedryss? How? He was pretty sure no one was watching him when he used it.
The senses of a transcendent expert were truly unrivaled.
In the end, Qingyi just sighed as he took Khaedryss out of the world of the mind and mounted it.
The dragon looked at the curious tiger for a brief moment before they both looked away, disinterested.
After Qingxue had also picked up her whirlwind phoenix, they both took off, following Yanxiao towards the north of the sect.
"Is that... the guardian’s residence?" Qingxue asked as she saw a burning valley on the horizon.
That place was in one of the sect’s forbidden zones, crowded with beasts from the Nascent Soul Realm and even the Rebirth Realm.
Few had the courage to come there, even with flying beasts.
Qingyi and Qingxue soon understood why when dozens of powerful auras focused on them.
But these auras soon ceased as Yanxiao released his Qi, driving them away.
"Guardian, why exactly did you bring us here?" Qingyi asked as they landed in the center of the valley, surrounded by pools of fiery magma.
Yanxiao slammed one of his claws into the black, burnt ground, causing it to open, revealing a small box.
"Do you know what this is?" he asked, and Qingyi shook his head in denial.
"You must already know what defines a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator and a Transcendence Realm cultivator.
In the nascent soul realm, you rebuild your soul itself, or, more precisely, its foundation.
This is how you acquire your world of mind, a world that is vital for advancing to the realm of transcendence, the realm where your soul is so powerful that it transcends the physical body."
Yanxiao raised his paw and it broke into tiny fragments of light before coming together again.
"In that realm, you can survive even if your heart is pierced and even if your body is totally destroyed, you still have a few hours to look for a new host before your soul totally decays.
The only way to truly kill a transcendent is to destroy their soul completely."
Yanxiao continued explaining, receiving the focused gazes of Qingxue and Qingyi.
It was obvious that no one there would pass up the chance to learn directly from a Transcendence Realm expert.
"This little thing here is a Mind World seed." The box opened, revealing a small whitish seed.
"These seeds help form a much more powerful world of mind and greatly increase the chances of advancing to the transcendence realm."
Those words shocked Qingyi and Qingxue.
They had both heard of such seeds, but they were so rare that they were only considered legends.
Hesitating for a brief moment, Qingyi searched for them in his system store.
Even the cheapest one was legendary grade and cost hundreds of thousands of lust points.
’System, is this of any use to me?’
[No. The host doesn’t need such items and, in fact, they would weaken or cause instabilities in his mind world. But it could be useful for his wives].
Hearing those words, Qingyi looked up. "What does the guardian want in exchange for these seeds?"
"Nothing, it’s a gift," Yanxiao said.
That thing had been rotting in storage for tens of thousands of years and it was about time it finally found a worthy owner.
"But still, I have a proposal for you. I want you to agree to be recommended to the Orthodox Alliance."
Qingyi lowered his head again.
He knew the Orthodox Alliance.
A place whose mortality rate was so high that half the disciples who went there died on their first mission.
It was on the edge of the Lands of Death, a part equivalent to 20% of the Nine Peaks Basin, totally controlled by non-Orthodox cultivators.
How could he not know them?
Now he understood perfectly why he had been given this gift.
As one of the founding members of the Orthodox Alliance, Yanxiao could send anyone he wanted there, regardless of the will of the sect leader.
But even so, he couldn’t force the disciples, not without using threats and bribes.
He probably planned to give Qingyi that pill as a way of making the handsome young man owe him and accept his request.
"Husband..." Qingxue grabbed Qingyi’s hand.
She trusted him, what really worried her was the fact that they might have to separate.
"I accept, but on one condition. Qingxue will come with me as my partner and will have no obligation to complete any missions."

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - Is that negotiable?
paragraphs: Yanxiao was naturally surprised by Qingyi’s request.
It wasn’t exactly something unusual, married disciples preferred to stay by their companions’ side, but wouldn’t having Qingxue only as a partner be a waste of her talents?
She would probably be a great help in increasing the merits of the sect if she were sent to the orthodox alliance, and Yanxiao felt his heart bleed slightly at the thought of wasting such a talent.
"Is that negotiable?" he asked.
Of course, he could threaten, use his power, force Qingyi to go for better or worse.
But Yanxiao wasn’t that kind of tiger.
"No." Qingyi shook his head, drawing a tired sigh from Yanxiao.
"Very well." He swung his paw in the air and the world around them distorted, a smile full of sharp teeth appearing on his feline face.
"I’ll also recommend that redhead, she’ll probably be useful to a man like you."
"R-redhead?" Qingyi stammered.
That damn tiger even knew about Rongyan?
Qingyi didn’t have time to question it while the teleportation formations in Yanxiao’s residence were activated and the two of them were sent back to the city of the eternal river.
In the end, he just exhaled heavily before focusing on the small box in his hands.
"Take it," he handed it to Qingxue.
"No, I don’t deserve this, use it on yourself!" She said, pushing the item back, although she was unable to hide the desire in her gaze.
It was obvious that she wanted it, but she believed that Qingyi would put the Mind World Seed to much better use.
"That’s useless to me, my lineage doesn’t allow me to use that kind of item. It will help you much more than me."
Qingxue still hesitated at those words, but in the end, she just bowed her head, accepting the item with a trembling look.
That was an item of incomparable value and she knew it very well.
After giving Qingxue a kiss and leaving her to cultivate, Qingyi left the sect in the direction of White Peak City.
His mind was totally focused on the Orthodox Alliance.
The Orthodox Alliance was the best-known and most renowned organization in the entire Nine Peaks Basin.

Founded around five thousand years ago by a group of 16 transcendents from the seven great families and nine great sects, the orthodox alliance was first created as a forum to discuss the political situation and the remnants of demonic worship in the Nine Peaks Basin.
But in recent centuries, everything has changed.
The demon cult began to revive, its troops invading the land like a plague, and rumors indicated that the current leader had reached the peak of the realm of transcendence.
Of course, this wouldn’t have been a big problem if it had been anyone else.
Yanxiao himself was at the peak of the transcendence realm, while three of the leaders of the nine great sects and two of the leaders of the seven great families had also reached this level.
But the problem was the bloodline of the demon cult leader.
The bloodline of the heavenly demon, a mortal-grade bloodline whose power placed him above everyone and everything.
It frightened even Yanxiao, and Qingyi knew it well.
It was because of this man that the orthodox alliance was converted into a military organization.
An organization totally focused on fighting the demon cult, with hundreds of thousands of powerful cultivators ready to die in the name of the orthodox way.
It was obvious that Qingyi would be taking a huge risk by joining the orthodox alliance.
But that risk barely crossed his mind when compared to the possible gains.
He was a little curious to know what that little demoness’s father was like.
But from the little he had talked about the leader of the demon cult with Ruyan, Qingyi already imagined that he would be someone he would probably have to kill in the future.
Shaking his head, Qingyi pushed those thoughts aside and made his way towards White Peak City.
Once there, he immediately went to meet the red-haired, explosive-tempered beauty in the city’s guard fortress.
She was, as usual, in her office, hunkered down with documents to sign, her eyes bearing black smudges of sleep.
But it wasn’t all bad.
She had also made a breakthrough in her cultivation, reaching the fourth stage of the Nascent Soul Realm.
"Qingyi? What are you doing here?" She raised her beautiful face, watching him enter her office.
Her heart palpitated immediately and she felt her whole body heat up.
She still felt strange about Qingyi.
One part of her wanted to hate him while the other wanted to love him more than anything and be grateful for the gift he had given her.
An improvement in her talent of that level was simply priceless and she couldn’t help but feel a little touched.
"What? A man can’t visit his wife anymore?"
Qingyi gave a teasing little smile as he pulled Rongyan into his embrace, pressing his lips against hers and grabbing her plump ass, squeezing hard.
"Nghnn~~ if you touched any other woman of my level, she’d castrate you, you know?" Rongyan gritted her teeth, unable to suppress her moans.
"Well... thank god you’re not any other woman of your level, hahaha," Qingyi laughed before wiping the smile off his face and assuming a serious expression.
"You don’t seem to be here for a good thing." Rongyan also turned serious.
"Maybe good, maybe bad, I’m not sure yet. The sect guardian wants to send me to the orthodox alliance and well... apparently, he’s going to transfer you there too."
Qingyi expected an explosive response from Rongyan, perhaps blaming him for something, cursing.
But to his surprise, her eyes were filled with an intense glow.
Being a White Peak City guard was her childhood dream, but honestly, it had already turned into a nightmare.
Qingyi’s words didn’t make her angry, quite the opposite.
Working in the Orthodox Alliance was much, much more prestigious than working in White Peak City and, above all, there was much less paperwork and much more action.
As a woman who liked to break bones, being transferred there was like a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - A figure Qingyi knew well
paragraphs: [Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 19
Cultivation: First stage of the Crystalline core Realm (100,000 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 98 - Sword: 97 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: High-level lightning sword root (100,000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Legendary grade, 2,500,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Legendary grade, 2,500,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Lust points: 100,431]
Qingyi looked at his status screen.
He hadn’t fucked Rongyan for long, but it was still enough to build up an acceptable emergency reserve in lust points.
Giving her a final kiss, he returned to the sect, where he began preparing to travel to the Orthodox Alliance.
Fortunately, they didn’t need much and after just over a week, they set off in one of the sect’s flying ships.
As the Orthodox Alliance was on the opposite side of the Nine Peaks Basin to the sect, the journey took a long time and only after almost a month of travel did they finally spot it on the horizon.

In the center was a large eastern palace, its main tower rising hundreds of meters high and its walls forming hexagons around the central palace, dividing the Alliance into seven parts that together amounted to dozens of square kilometers.
Those seven parts represented the seven battalions of the Alliance.
The Azure Battalion, the Red Battalion, the Supreme Saber Battalion, the Dead Moon Battalion, the Ascending Sun Battalion, the Snake Battalion and, finally, the Dragon Battalion.
Each of those battalions was led by Rebirth Realm cultivators, divided into squads led by Nascent Soul Realm cultivators.
"Greetings, fellow disciple." A strong hand fell on the shoulder of Qingyi, who was sitting next to Qingxue on one of the many rows of seats on the sect’s flying ship.
Turning around, Qingyi saw a man with a sharp smile and penetrating gaze, watching him animatedly.
He was a Nascent Soul Realm expert, and a powerful one.
"You’re new here, aren’t you? Have you chosen which battalion you’re going to join? I can help you choose if you like, hehehe." He spoke and without even asking permission, sat down next to Qingyi.
"Oh... where are my manners, I’m Wei Longhu, a veteran and leader of the Dragon Battalion’s thirty-seventh squad.
I’m not going to force you into anything, but I really recommend that you choose us, you certainly won’t regret it, hehehe." Longhu laughed.
"Thanks for the advice, senior brother Longhu. I’m Long Qingyi, I’ll take your words into consideration when I choose my battalion." Qingyi replied, a little uncomfortable with Longhu’s gaze.
That guy looked like a snake and his breath wasn’t good.
Turning his face, he touched the shoulders of Qingxue who was sleeping to his left, her head resting on his shoulder.
That touch woke her up immediately, her cold, serene eyes focusing on Longhu for a brief moment before turning to her beloved.
She didn’t like the look in that guy’s eyes either.
Fortunately, they were soon forced to move away as the ship docked and a powerful aura from the Realm of Rebirth fell over them.
A man wearing military clothes entered the part of the ship where they were staying, accompanied by two other people.
One of them was a tall, grumpy man while the other was someone Qingyi knew well - Rongyan.

The red-haired beauty had been on the same ship as them, but as she was considered a public servant of the sect-ruled White Peak City, she ended up having to be transferred to the Orthodox Alliance in a slightly different way to them.
The eyes of the man in military clothes swept over everyone there before he clicked his tongue.
"One hundred and fifty, that’s a good number." He said, preparing his throat.
"You’re here because someone saw potential in you, potential to fight the damned demons who destroy our cities, corrupt our lands and poison our water." He roared.
His aura became even more intense, the space around him coming close to collapsing before he eased off, allowing everyone there to breathe.

"Everyone must leave this ship immediately and report to the central courtyard of the Orthodox Alliance fortress. There, you will take part in a friendly competition and then you will be able to choose which battalion you wish to join."
Speaking those words, the man turned and left immediately;
Rongyan cast one last glance in Qingyi’s direction before leaving too, her beautiful face subtly blushing.
The handsome young man only sighed as he stood up with Qingxue, walking towards the exit of the flying ship.
Outside, they were immediately greeted by a courtyard filled with thousands of disciples from countless sects, all waiting anxiously for their turn.
In the center of the courtyard was an arena, the stone platform that represented it spreading almost a thousand meters, powerful barriers preventing the fight from moving away from its interior.
Raising his gaze, Qingyi saw the battalion leaders sitting on a luxurious platform.
Although each battalion had several members of the Rebirth Realm, there was only one leader among them, usually the strongest or most prestigious.
Qingyi suddenly felt his heart pounding.
Among them was a figure he knew well.
A woman with green eyes that seemed to have a glow of their own, full, rosy lips and huge boobs whose pale skin from her cleavage shone under the soft sunlight that reflected against them.
It was Tang Biyue, the leader of the Snake Battalion.
Qingyi watched her with shock for a brief moment.
Before he even had a chance to turn around, he felt a penetrating gaze focusing on him and saw the cold, composed expression on her face change.
She had noticed him too.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - It’s not possible...
paragraphs: Tang Biyue stood up, her huge breasts almost escaping from her cleavage because of the speed of the movement, jiggling wildly as she stared at the scene in front of her.
Were her eyes lying to her?
’No... It’s not possible...’ She repeated in her mind, feeling her heart pounding.
A faint blush spread across her cheeks like burning flames and she felt a familiar warmth rise in her belly.
It was the same feeling she had whenever she came into contact with Qingyi.
She spread her senses, feeling Qingyi’s cultivation, something that made the trembling in her eyes even more intense.
From the foundation realm to the crystalline core realm in less than two years?
How could that be possible? Not even her family’s ancestor had such a fast cultivation speed!
"Is there a problem, Lady Tang Biyue?" A voice echoed from behind the poisonous beauty.
It was the leader of the dragon battalion, a powerful man, handsome and tall, bearing sharp, brutish features.
His golden eyes shone softly, a point of lust appearing in them before he suppressed it.
"I’m fine," Tang Biyue forced firmness into her voice, sitting down again and closing her eyes, trying to calm her racing mind.
She wasn’t well and she knew it.
Even after almost a year without seeing Qingyi, there wasn’t a single night when she didn’t have to fight the urge to touch herself.
It was as if there was an invisible mark on her body, always there, throbbing and reminding her of him.
She exchanged glances with the young man one last time before focusing on the competition.
Two elders of the orthodox alliance suddenly appeared in the sky.
"As you may have heard from one of the alliance officials, you will have to take part in a friendly competition to test your true combat power.

This is not a way of defining who will or will not join the orthodox alliance, just a way of demonstrating your power to each of the battalion leaders, who will decide whether or not you will be accepted into the battalions you choose.
Those who aren’t accepted by any leader, don’t be discouraged, you can still serve directly on the council of elders as a civil servant."
Qingyi had already looked away from Tang Biyue and was now also focusing on the elder.
He had some idea of what the council of elders was.
Although the battalion leaders had total control over their own battalions, these elders were still the true commanders of the orthodox alliance, second only to the transcendents who founded it.
Rongyan wouldn’t be taking part in this competition because the sect had transferred her directly to the service of the council of elders.
"Even so, there will be a reward for the one who takes first place in this competition: the opportunity to choose a treasure from the orthodox alliance’s storage."
Those words caused a slight stir among the disciples who were about to enter the alliance.
It was the reward given in every competition, a way of putting old and abandoned treasures into circulation and rewarding the most talented.
Even so, the reaction was always the same - shock and excitement, especially among those who had a chance of winning.
After the announcement, all the competitors had to sign their name on a small nameplate before finally starting to fight.
Qingyi was in the middle of the list, so it would be a while before it was his turn.
The first competitors were two young men at the peak of the crystalline core realm.
The first was a flame cultivator who used double swords, each of his attacks capable of making the surrounding air boil.
The second was a water and fist cultivator.
Soon, an elder announced the start of the battle and dozens of blows were exchanged in a single moment, water vapor taking over the arena as they fought.
The battle ended after exactly fifty exchanges, with a water fist hitting the fire cultivator’s chest and sending him flying backwards.
After that, a few hundred battles followed until it was finally Qingyi’s turn.
His opponent was a cultivator of the sixth stage of the crystalline core realm with a lightning spirit root.
As a disciple of a minor sect, his name was unknown and his prestige non-existent.
But he still had a confident smile on his face as he stared at Qingyi.
"You can call this one Young Master Yu. Please, junior, don’t be offended that this one isn’t kind."
Young Master Yu grinned at Qingyi as his sword slid out of its scabbard with a sharp hiss, immediately seized by a powerful thunderous aura.

He was the most powerful disciple in his sect and even if his sect wasn’t comparable to the Eternal River Sect, he still had the confidence to easily defeat someone with a cultivation so much lower than his own.
Why would the Eternal River Sect send someone of such low cultivation to such a place? He didn’t know, nor did he care.
Only victory mattered.
"I won’t be offended, Young Master Yu, don’t worry about it." Qingyi returned the confident smile as he drew the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
It wasn’t nice to be looked down on by someone so weak, but he didn’t even think much of it.
Young Master Yu would have to swallow all that unfounded arrogance one way or another.
The moment the elder gave the order, they both moved forward.
The air around them exploded and the ground shook, torn apart by the thunder of both of them as their bodies closed the distance of hundreds of meters in just a single second.
When their swords met, a shockwave echoed and Young Master Yu’s face filled with terror.
Qingyi’s sword seemed to sink into his as if it were made of butter, the molten steel tip falling to the ground with a loud clang.
That sword was his sect’s greatest treasure, a gift from the sect leader himself for Yu to demonstrate his power.
But against Qingyi’s, it looked just like a toy sword.
Young master Yu barely had time to react as Qingyi’s boots met his shocked face.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - I want to join the snake battalion
paragraphs: Young Master Yu was sent flying by Qingyi’s kick, shattered teeth and an explosion of blood spurting from his open mouth as his body spun through the air before falling heavily to the ground.
Soon, dozens of murmurs echoed among the stunned onlookers.
"That boy beat a cultivator five stages above him without any special techniques?"
"That sword seemed to be at least an ancient artifact, how powerful is his lightning sword Qi?"
"The sword he uses doesn’t look simple either."
Qingyi ignored those murmurs, raising his gaze to the seven battalion leaders who were watching him with obvious interest.
But he only focused on two people.
The first was Long Tianyu, the leader of the Dragon Battalion and one of the Rebirth Realm cultivators who was closest to advancing to the Transcendence Realm of his generation.
The second was Tang Biyue, leader of the snake battalion.
"That boy’s name is Long Qingyi, right?" Tianyu sniffed the air, flashing a proud smile. "He’s a dragon too, just like me, and a powerful one."
"You were watching him as if you knew him." Tianyu sent Biyue an interested look. "Tell me little beauty, what do you know about him?"
"Don’t call me that." Biyue bit her lower lip, a little anger appearing on her beautiful, slightly flushed face.
Tianyu just shook his head in frustration, obviously noticing Tang Biyue’s shortness of breath.
What on earth had that junior done to make his future wife react like that?
Long Tianyu wondered.
Suddenly, his view of Qingyi was no longer so positive.
The elder running the competition hesitated for a brief moment before waving his hands and declaring Qingyi the winner.
The handsome young man only exchanged a last glance with Tang Biyue before returning to his seat.
Fortunately, her corruption was already quite high and even without approaching her, he seemed to be able to affect her.
At least her being like this greatly reduced the chances of her simply killing him.
"Is that the expert who kidnapped the husband?" A sweet, serene voice echoed next to Qingyi as delicate fingers grasped her arm, pulling it against a pair of large, soft tits.
It was Qingxue, who was watching Biyue curiously.
"Yes, she’s that expert." Qingyi replied, receiving a suspicious look from Qingxue.
That husband of hers was certainly hiding something, but she was simply unable to know what it was.
The rest of the battles went smoothly.
Qingyi really didn’t face anyone close to his level, defeating each of his opponents with one or at most two or three blows.
With each new battle, the look of desire among all the battalion leaders became even more intense and even Tianyu had to repress his negative desire towards Qingyi.
Fuck the relationship between that young man and his future wife, what really mattered was taking him for the Dragon Battalion!
They were already the strongest battalion, but with another talent like that, they would be unstoppable even against the council of elders.
It wasn’t long before it was finally time for the final battle of the competition.
This time, Qingyi would fight Shuang Hu, the young ice master of the Hidden Moon Sect, one of the most powerful of the nine great sects.
Even though Qingyi was powerful, no one there believed that he would be a match for Shuang Hu’s ice tiger bloodline.
Long Qingyi just ignored all those stares as he climbed onto the platform, his eyes focused on Shuang Hu.
Sharp silver eyes, long white hair and a face only slightly less beautiful than Qingyi’s.

Despite Qingyi being his opponent, Shuang Hu didn’t even pay attention to the handsome young man in front of him, focusing his gaze on the silver-haired beauty he had been talking to just a few moments ago.
[She’s your wife, right? Is she still pure? I can pay good money for her if she’s still pure."]
Qingyi received a voice transmission and the gentle smile on his face completely fell apart.
He had heard rumors about Shuang Hu being a lustful bastard while watching him fight.
But to dare lay eyes on his Qingxue like that...
Qingyi gritted his teeth, unable to control his murderous intent.
"Begin!" The moment the elder’s voice echoed, Shuang Hu acted.
A huge tiger with white fur and blue eyes appeared on his back, the air around him dropping in temperature rapidly.
Just a second after the battle began, the entire arena was already covered in a thick sheet of ice.
It was a frightening power, but Qingyi didn’t even flinch.
"Do you want to show off? Good... I’ll show you what real power is." The handsome young man laughed and the ice above his feet cracked, being turned to dust by his lightning sword Qi.
In the next moment, the whole world seemed to come to a standstill as his bloodline Qi leaked out, the head of a black-scaled dragon with purple eyes appearing on his back.
A deafening roar spread throughout the orthodox alliance, even the elders trembled slightly in the face of that power.
But the most affected was Tang Biyue.
Her thick, soft thighs rubbed against each other desperately and her breathing became gasping.
Looking away, she focused her gaze on the other women on that place.
They were all slightly flushed, but only her body reacted so miserably.
Why was this only happening to her?
She tried to control herself and focus on the battle, but it truly felt like a lost fight.
"D-don’t come any closer!" Shuang Hu barely had time to shout as Qingyi swung the heaven-defying thunder sword, only using the side of his sword.
He was trying to cause pain, not win.
The mighty Shuang Hu was quickly reduced to a crying baby as Qingyi’s blows struck him, each one focusing on his face, his beauty quickly being erased under a series of devastating impacts.
It was only after long moments that the elders finally intervened.

"Very well young man, there’s no need to be so ruthless, the fight is over, you’ve won. Choose the battalion you wish to join and then accompany me to receive your prize," the elder declared, stopping Qingyi’s sword.
"Greetings, elder, pardon the disrespect." The handsome young man bowed respectfully. "About the battalion I wish to join..."
He raised his vision, studying each of the battalions.
The dragon battalion would obviously be the best for him.
But that wouldn’t be fun, would it?
With a teasing smile, he looked at Biyue.
"I want to join the snake battalion."

"Is there any way of creating something similar by uniting fire and ice?"
[The host will know the answer to this question when he reaches the realm of transcendence].
Really?
Thank you for your great help." Qingyi spat sarcastically.
He hated that kind of answer, but if the system didn’t want to talk, there was little he could do.
With a sigh, he raised his index finger and a thin sword Qi emerged from the tip of his fingernail, this Qi soon being surrounded by a thunderous aura.
This was the result of uniting sword Qi and lightning Qi.
As they were already Qi of extremely high affinity, the result was not very interesting, just the union of the sharpness of sword Qi and the heat and destructive power of lightning Qi.
Fire and ice, on the other hand, would probably result in something much more interesting.
"Ruxue" He called out "What do you think about fusing fire and ice spirit roots?"

"Hmm... that would normally result in a considerably painful death, but with the power of your body and your bloodline, there shouldn’t be any problems." A sweet, mature voice echoed as a voluptuous, sensual figure appeared behind Qingyi.
A huge pair of breasts pressed against his back as she hugged him, her beautiful purple eyes watching him curiously.
"Are you going to do this?" She asked.
After a moment’s thought, Qingyi nodded and prepared himself.
The chances of fire and ice spirit roots merging was much lower than the chances of sword and lightning, which had a much greater affinity.
So he had to be careful.
With a soft grunt, he clicked to buy new spirit roots.
His whole body froze in the next moment, his eyes watered and he let a pained grunt escape his lips.
No matter how many times he did it, he was unable to get used to the pain.

As his meridians were rebuilt to contain the new Qi, the temperature around him dropped rapidly, reaching negative values before exploding, so hot that it seemed capable of melting steel, his body completely engulfed in a sea of flames.
Qingyi was already feeling the formations in the cultivation room begin to suffer damage when he was finally able to open his eyes.
A shockwave spread throughout his body and then everything calmed down.
[Failed to fuse fire and ice spirit roots! roots absorbed as two-colored spiritual roots.]
[Your spirit roots have changed!
Lightning sword spirit root -> three-colored spirit root (Lightning sword, fire, ice)]
’A failure...’ Qingyi gritted his teeth, but didn’t think much of it.
It was expected and honestly, it probably wouldn’t damage his plans.
The temperature returned to normal and Qingyi stood up, feeling the new type of Qi in his body.
It was a little strange, but not in a bad way.
Extending his right hand, he surrounded it with an intense Qi of fire and, at the same time, extended his left, surrounding it with a powerful Qi of ice.

The cultivation room was immediately divided into two sides, one taken by a scorching Qi and illuminated by a deep orange while the other was taken by a freezing Qi and illuminated by a soft blue, thin layers of ice forming on the walls.
After a moment’s hesitation, Qingyi pointed his left hand forward before making an upward gesture.
In the next moment, a large wall of ice appeared, only to be destroyed by a flaming attack.
The control was good.
Most cultivators would need a combat technique to be able to channel their power like that, but Qingyi was already able to do it by himself without difficulty.

’Just one more little thing...’ Qingyi smiled as he pressed his hands against each other, drawing the two Qi’s at the same time and trying to unite them, just as he had done with the sword and lightning Qi.
The resistance was absurd, like two super-powerful magnets trying to repel each other at all costs.
But he didn’t let himself be discouraged, pushing harder and harder, gritting his teeth.
"I know what you want to do, it’s no use, the husband doesn’t know enough about the laws of nature to be capable of something like this." Ruxue said as she approached Qingyi, shaking her head.
"Laws of nature?" Qingyi stopped what he was doing, turning his face towards the spiritual beauty.
"Yes, you’ll start to understand them as soon as you reach the transcendence realm and they’ll become more and more noticeable until you finally reach the heavenly heavens.
For now, don’t waste time thinking about it."
"I see..." Qingyi sighed.
The transcendence realm... it would still take him a long time to get there.
With a sigh, Qingyi stood up, stretching his body slightly before finally leaving the cultivation room.
"Junior brother Qingyi, you’re back - ugh..." Yedu’s voice suddenly stopped and he almost vomited.
"Uh... has junior brother undergone body reconstruction?" he asked.
I’m sorry!" Qingyi noticed his own smell and hurried to his room, taking a long shower and washing away all the impurities that permeated his skin.
Once he was finally clean, he returned to the main hall of the twenty-third squadron’s private pavilion, feeling much more relaxed.
All three other members of the squadron were already there, staring at a map on the floor.
Yedu focused his eyes on Qingyi.
"Congratulations on your body reconstruction, junior brother Qingyi, it’s been a few years since I went through one, hahaha" Yedu laughed, but the laughter soon ceased.
Qingyi’s aura had changed and was much more powerful than before.
Had Qingyi made a breakthrough in his cultivation too?
Only then did Yedu realize.
Qingyi was already at the peak of the crystalline core realm...
How was that humanly possible?

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - Her soul isn’t the same.
paragraphs: After the other three members of the group got over the shock of Qingyi’s tremendous breakthrough speed, they could only sigh in defeat.
Everyone there thought they were geniuses... but how could they compare to Qingyi?
Fortunately, they couldn’t spend too much time thinking about it. Their mission would start soon and they needed to get organized.
The aim of the mission was simple: to get close to some key figures in the demon cult, extract information and then leave.
Among these figures was the current heir to the demon cult and the only one of his generation to inherit the Heavenly Demon bloodline.
Ruyan had spoken a little about this figure and Qingyi was already sure that it was someone who should die.
Not only was the demon cult’s young lord a sadistic son of a bitch, but he was even a disgusting incestuous man who had sexual interests in his own sister.
At the very least, Qingyi would castrate him for that.
After discussing the key figures and the information they needed to obtain from them, it was time to define the form of infiltration.
The demon cult received thousands of members every year, so it wasn’t too difficult to blend in.
The only problem was that they also had many demon cultivators infiltrating the orthodox alliance and these cultivators naturally reported everything, including their faces.
Fortunately, the fat man was an expert in illusions and knew just how to solve this with simple artifacts; spirit masks.
These masks would change their appearance completely, but not only that.
They would also change their Qi, adding strands of demonic Qi to it.
Qingyi had to admit that this was incredible as he raised his hand and covered it with lightning Qi.
It was identical to his normal Qi, only tinged with a disgusting smell and a reddish color.
"Any more questions?" Yedu asked.

After everyone shook their heads in denial, he smiled softly. "Good, we’ll be leaving together at dusk in two days, we’re going on foot, so the journey should take a few weeks, prepare yourselves well."
Without further ado, Yedu got up and went back to his room.
Qingyi did the same, closing his eyes and entering the world of Ruxue’s mind, where he threw himself onto the large imperial bed and began to cultivate with his wives.
As the difference in cultivation between him and them grew, and the first of them reached mortal grade spirit roots, their cultivation speed naturally exploded even more.
Soon, Yunfei, Feiyan, Elize and Yueli all reached the crystalline core realm, while the other girls reached the burning blood realm.
He really wanted to spend a bit more time with them, but it was about time to leave and he had one last thing to see.
The temple’s spiritual garden, a huge plantation managed directly by Feiyan and Yueli, surrounded by spiritual arrays capable of greatly accelerating the growth of spiritual herbs.
The first ones planted by Feiyan were already about to ripen, but they honestly didn’t catch Qingyi’s eye.
They had been planted a few months ago and were only plants from the outer region of the continent, with almost no value in the nine peaks basin.
He was only going to buy a few more seeds before he left, but then he remembered something.
Opening his storage ring, he pulled out a small plant.
A white flower in the shape of a rose, its petals crystalline and icy, exuding a Qi of ice that was powerful enough to make him shudder, even after all his breakthroughs.
That was the flower he had obtained after rescuing Yunfei in the forbidden zone of the Heavenly Spirit Mountain.
As well as freezing the world around it, it also had a rather interesting effect: it gathered pure Qi and made the spiritual herbs around it grow much faster.
Walking to the center of the plantation, Qingyi knelt down and planted it there.
The change around it was instantaneous, its roots clinging desperately to the ground, a powerful ice Qi spreading out of control.
Normally, this kind of Qi would kill everything, but that’s not what happened.
The herbs around it grew stronger, even the fire Qi herbs filling with vitality.
Qingyi didn’t know how long it would last, but he had to admit that it was incredible.
Buying some more higher-level seeds for Feiyan, Qingyi left.
If his plans worked out, he wouldn’t even need to spend any more lust points on resources for Feiyan to produce his pills.
Ruxue’s world of the mind would be able to provide the girls with everything they needed.
Of course, the cost of keeping it stable was rising sharply and he still needed to supply Ruxue with a lot of Qi crystals, but that was something he would deal with another time.
Many thousands of kilometers away, the Eternal River Sect was as calm as ever.
"Are you sure about this?" Yanxiao asked an old man with gray hair and senile eyes in front of him.
"Yes! Of course I am, do you think those little eyes are lying to me? I saw this woman a few centuries ago and now, I’ve seen her again.
I assure you, her soul isn’t the same, she’s being controlled, controlled by something that came through that hole in the heavens twenty-nine years ago! Think about it, it all makes sense!"
Hearing those words, Yanxiao gritted his teeth.
That man was the greatest soul cultivator in the entire nine peaks basin, someone he had personally called to meet the sect leader and, without being noticed, take a look at her.
Listening to his opinion, it all made sense.
About twenty-nine years ago, a hole between the mortal and immortal heavens opened up in a place where his sect leader was.
In that same time, her personality changed almost completely and she built the secret realm of the supreme beast, a feat that he was sure was beyond her abilities.
The difficulty with Qi, the change in personality... how could he not have thought of this before?
If she was being controlled by someone, it all made sense.
"Thank you very much for your help, I’ll pay you well for your services." Yanxiao said as he turned around. "For now, I’ll put the sect leader under house arrest and continue investigating."

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - New techniques
paragraphs: The Nine Peaks Basin was generally a lush, green place.
There were deserts and large freezing plains, but these were rare.
Pale or yellowish spots on a continent of green.
So it was easy to notice the arrival in the dead lands.
The green grass turned into a dry brown carpet that gradually darkened to black, as did the withered and broken trees that surrounded it.

Everything there exuded a sickly poisonous Qi, incapable of harming a high-level cultivator, but strong enough to kill a mortal in a few hours, even though the poison was over twenty thousand years old and now carried only a fraction of the power it once had.
Qingyi walked alone through these dark lands.
His face had changed, as had his voice, taking on the face of an ordinary middle-aged man, with a hoarse, deep tone.
To avoid suspicion, the group had split up, taking separate and isolated routes towards the dead lands.
Qingyi took the northern route, passing a small border fort before finally entering the corrupted territory.
He had to admit that it was a strange place.
The air was hard to breathe and the few animals he encountered were bizarre and extremely powerful mutations.
He was about to call Khaedryss to get to the demon cult as quickly as possible, but stopped at the last moment.
An explosion echoed on the horizon, followed by a bestial roar and a powerful reddish-black demonic Qi spreading across the sky.
Without hesitation, Qingyi gave a gentle push and his body rose into the sky, climbing a few hundred meters until he came into view of a forgotten valley.
There, two powerful beasts were fighting desperately: a corrupted fire lizard and a demonic snake.
Their huge bodies were pressed against each other, each stretching for dozens of meters, exuding a powerful Nascent Soul Realm Qi.
Qingyi thought about ignoring it, but after thinking for a moment, he realized that it was a good time to test his new spiritual roots.
Opening the system store, he searched for combat techniques for each of them, choosing a defensive technique for his ice Qi and an offensive technique for his fire Qi.
[Item: Eternal Wall of the Icy Lord.
Description: Forms an ice barrier in any shape desired by the user. It can be formed over the feet of enemies to hold them in place.
Rank: Legendary
Price: 150,000 lust points]
[Item: Art of the nine spears of celestial fire.
Description: A technique focused on forming spears of fire, each spear carrying twice the power and twice the cost of the previous spear.
Grade: Mortal
Price: 400,000 lust points]
With a heavy heart, Qingyi paid the five hundred and fifty thousand lust points.
An intense pain ran through his head as the information about the techniques invaded his mind.
It was painful, but it was worth it.
He was already able to make walls of ice with his Qi alone, but these walls were of no use in a real battle, with no strength or foundation.
The same went for spears of fire - Qi channeled without technique or artifacts was often useless when dealing with cultivators above the golden core realm.
With a soft grunt, he stretched out his right hand.
A huge spear of flame formed in his palm, the fire consuming the air and heating everything around.
Twisting his body in the air, Qingyi threw the first spear, a shockwave exploding as it broke through the sound barrier.
Sensing the danger, the two beasts immediately stopped fighting, looking up.
The giant fire lizard retreated briefly while the demonic serpent roared towards the spear, a barrier of demonic Qi forming around it.
A loud bang echoed as the ethereal spear shattered against the demonic barrier in a fiery explosion, barely making it tremble.
Despite this, Qingyi was not discouraged.
Another spear formed in his hands, this one even more powerful than the last, sucking in his Qi voraciously.
His eyes shone as he threw it towards the snake.
The speed of the spear increased even more, this time powerful enough to cause small cracks in the creature’s barrier.
"Power is good..." Qingyi muttered as he summoned a third spear.
He hadn’t even used his lineage projection, but he could already break through the defenses of an Enlightened Soul Realm beast. "But the cost not so much." He gritted his teeth.

It was much more expensive than the Storm Monarch’s sword art and, honestly, it was only useful against large, slow beasts, not very effective against human cultivators, not without him using his draconic eyes to calculate the trajectory and the eternal wall of the icy lord to imprison them in place.
Still, he was satisfied.
Without further hesitation, he threw the third spear.
A sea of flames engulfed everything in front of him as it landed under the serpent’s barrier, which finally shattered completely.
Qingyi drew his heaven-defying thunder sword and activated the lightning steps.
His body disappeared into the cloud of dust as he used the first and second forms of the Storm Monarch’s sword art in quick succession, focusing everything on the demonic beast’s neck.
The third form finally broke through its scales, decapitating it.
He barely had time to let out a sigh of relief when he was forced to use the ice wall, forming a defensive barrier around him and protecting himself from a powerful fireball.
The attack came from the fire lizard, which was watching him with interest.
Qingyi thought about dealing with it himself, but in the end just shook his head.
He had already tested his power, Khaedryss could handle it.
Waving in the air, the huge black dragon appeared, almost twice the size of the flame lizard.
The beast barely had time to scream as Khaedryss sank her razor-sharp teeth into its throat, delighting in the creature’s Qi-rich blood.
Qingyi just watched as the dragon devoured its still-living prey, smiling softly as he felt Khaedryss’ power increase.
She was no longer so far from the power of a beast in the Rebirth realm.
After she had devoured both beasts, Qingyi climbed onto her back and they took off towards the horizon.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - Interesting figure...
paragraphs: The demon cult was one of the largest and most powerful organizations in the nine peaks basin, on an individual level, probably more powerful than any of the nine great sects and seven great families.
Naturally, its base was worthy of such power and wealth.
A sea of luxurious pavilions stretched as far as the eye could see, surrounded by high walls and a city where crime was basically legalized.
Qingyi passed through this city, his eyes encountering atrocities of all kinds.
Prostitution, human trafficking, slavery, not even children were spared.
He had to stop the vomit from rising to his throat as he forced a cold face, ignoring the prostitutes who smiled provocatively at him.
It was a difficult task, but he managed to do it, arriving in front of the sect’s wide gate, where a few hundred people were already waiting to be selected.
Qingyi scanned the faces of everyone there, finding none of his three companions.
Each of those people exuded a powerful murderous intent, with sharp eyes full of hatred.
But they were no match for the one masked elder who watched them all coldly.
"Ugh... Garbage... garbage... garbage... almost garbage... garbage..." The elder muttered, his fingers tapping anxiously against the wood of his mask.
Standing up, he waved to the recruits. "What are you waiting for? Start the massacre! Five of you should be left." The elder raised both hands in the air, his body trembling.
No one there was surprised or even hesitated.
That was normal.
During the demon sect’s selection month, every day dozens or hundreds of challengers would gather in front of its gates and fight to the death, leaving only five.
This was the third day of the selection, but a countless amount of blood had already been spilled on the ground.
Qingyi was the only one taken by surprise, narrowly dodging as a blade passed inches from his neck.
If he had taken longer than a blink to dodge, he would surely have been beheaded.
Drawing his heaven-defying thunder sword, he slashed, severing his attacker’s hand before piercing his heart.
Qingyi barely paid attention to the look of pain and terror he received from that dying demonic cultivator before moving on to the next one.
The fight was complete chaos.
Cultivators from the Nascent Soul Realm and the Crystalline Core Realm were completely mixed up, the weakest being slaughtered without a chance to react.
The numbers began to fall rapidly and soon only ten were left standing.
Qingyi erected an ice barrier around himself, the illusory mask creating a false demonic Qi in his ice Qi as he fended off a pincer attack from two other cultivators.
Leaping into the air, he used his Eternal Wall of the Icy Lord technique again, focusing it on the feet of the two cultivators.
"Damn, I’m stuck!" one of the cultivators realized, swinging his sword towards the ice beneath his feet in an attempt to break it.
The other tried to do the same, using his flaming Qi to set everything in front of him ablaze, trying to melt that ice.
But it was no use and Qingyi’s blade soon cut their throats.
When that happened, there were only four of them left.
The masked elder stopped, a high-pitched, crazy laugh escaping his lips as he leapt off the wall, stopping in front of Qingyi.
Of the four, Qingyi was the only one not at the Nascent Soul Realm.
"Interesting figure... very interesting figure! Hahahaha!" The masked elder laughed, studying every bit of Qingyi’s features, who was unable to hide the discomfort on his face.
"Come with me," he said as he waved to the demon disciples accompanying him. "Clean up the bodies and prepare for the next selection, may the heavenly demon bless you."
Without hesitating any longer, the elder led the four.
"As disciples, you must accept the heavenly demon within you," he said, stopping in front of a small dragon-shaped statue.

That answer made Qingyi’s eyes light up instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - Xue Mo
paragraphs: "Repeat what you said..." A loud, hate-filled voice left the lips of a man of youthful beauty, short black hair and piercing red eyes, a pair of horns rising from his head.
"Lady Ruyan has taken a servant, Y-young lord, a new recruit. She seems to have locked herself in her mansion with him and avoided going out as much as possible."
The servant’s words were answered by a loud crack as the glass goblet in the man’s hands shattered, fragments scattering across the floor.
That man was the young lord of the demon cult, the demon lord’s rightful and only heir.
"Who is that? Who dares approach my sister?" he roared, the whole building shaking as he stood up, his demonic aura expanding uncontrollably.
"He is-" The servant tried to speak, but was interrupted when the door to the private room they were in opened, revealing a powerful, dignified-looking man wearing imposing crimson armor.
"What do you want? I’m busy." Young lord Xue Mo growled as he turned around.
That man was a member of the Crimson Guard, a group of a hundred private protectors of the demon lord, each one a cultivator at the peak of the Rebirth Realm.
Even so, Xue Mo showed him no respect.
"Young master Xue Mo, your father requires your presence immediately." The guard spoke and the anger on Xue Mo’s face finally disappeared.
"What does father want?"
"I dare not presume on our lord’s thoughts, young master."
"Ah... fuck." Xue Mo got up and left with the guard, the servant following right behind.
Qingyi stopped in front of one of the richest and most luxurious establishments in the city that surrounded the demon cult.
A building that rose more than twenty stories, its façade seemed to have been dipped in gold and on its door, a large, bright sign read: Dead Moon Pavilion.
That was where the signal from Ruxue’s fragment was coming from.
Qingyi hesitated for a brief moment before entering the main entrance , where he was immediately greeted by an attendant in long, elegant robes.
"Greetings, honored customer. What can I do for you? Do you need a bed for the night? Food? Cultivation rooms? The Dead Moon Pavilion has it all!" She spoke, flashing a professional smile.
"I-" before Qingyi had even finished his sentence, a commotion gripped the entire building, a powerful demonic aura exploding for a brief moment before ceasing.
A few moments later, three figures appeared: a guard in crimson armor, an ordinary-looking servant and finally, a man with a handsome, youthful face.
"Qingyi, my fragment is with one of those three!" Ruxue’s voice echoed in Qingyi’s mind, but he ignored it, focusing his eyes on one of the three figures.
His appearance perfectly matched the description of the young demon cult lord given to Qingyi by Ruyan.
While observing the three, Qingyi’s eyes met those of the servant, who immediately shuddered.
"Y-young lord..." He whispered to Xue Mo, who completely ignored him.
Gathering his courage, he finally grabbed the young lord’s sleeve. "Y-young lord, this is-"
"Did I give you permission to touch me? Worm." Xue Mo suddenly stopped his steps, turning to the servant.
"N-no, young lord, it’s just that-" The servant’s head exploded under Xue Mo’s bloodthirsty gaze, his murderous intent locking everyone in place as the headless corpse fell to the ground.
Even Qingyi shuddered.
It was powerful, far beyond his current power.
Qingyi immediately realized that he would need to advance to the Nascent Soul Realm to fight on an equal footing with that guy.
"Fucking worms... you give them a bit of responsibility and suddenly they think they have power over something." Xue Mo spat on the corpse before turning around, his eyes finally meeting Qingyi’s.
From his clothes, he was a newcomer to the cult and from his apparent age and cultivation, he had a miserable talent, mediocre at best.
Xue Mo seemed to think for a brief moment before waving his hands, a small token appearing from the servant’s clothes and floating over to Qingyi.
"You will be my new personal servant, report to my palace in three days at dawn." Without giving Qingyi time to reply, Xue Mo left with the guard.
The handsome young man remained frozen in place for long moments, still unable to process everything that had just happened.
"Ah... there’s nothing I can do." Qingyi shook his head.
Well, at least now he had an idea of Xue Mo’s power and was almost certain that he was the one carrying Ruxue’s fragment.
He also knew that someone had reported the fact that Ruxue had taken him to her mansion.
Perhaps one of the other three recruits or the masked elder himself who had recruited him into the demon cult.
Whoever it was, Qingyi would keep it in mind.
It wasn’t long before the corpse was cleaned up and the attendant approached Qingyi, this time even more respectfully.
"Dear customer, can we get you something?"
The handsome young man thought for a moment before nodding, asking for some wine and boiled mutton.
He had a slight headache and really needed to fill his stomach.
He was sure that Elize would be more than happy to cook for him now, but she was cultivating with the other girls and he didn’t want to disturb her.
After eating and paying, Qingyi set off in the direction of the tavern where he would meet his companions.
It was a remote place in the outskirts of the demon cult city.
Hesitating for a brief moment, Qingyi entered.
"You’re late, I thought you were dead." A tired voice caught Qingyi’s attention and he immediately turned around.
At a far table, two men were sitting.
It was Yedu and fattie Heidu.
"I’ve had a few annoyances, where’s Mojie?" Qingyi asked as he sat down at the table.
Apart from them, the place was completely empty, surrounded by sound suppression and concealment arrays.
"Dead." Yedu replied, clenching his fists.
"We were at the selection together, I tried to protect him but I ended up between two cultivators at the peak of the Nascent Soul Realm. I couldn’t do much."

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - Sea of mind
paragraphs: "I’m sorry." Qingyi lowered his gaze.
He didn’t know much about Mojie, but he didn’t seem like a bad person.
"It’s natural," Yedu shook his head. "People always die, that’s how this line of work works."
After these words, there was a moment of silence before Yedu regained his composure.
"We need to organize some things now, get ready to contact the targets and confirm this information." Yedu said, taking out a document and handing it to Qingyi.
The handsome young man took the document, reading it calmly.
That calm didn’t last long, soon turning to deep shock.

That document was a report from another undercover group, claiming that the chief strategist was seriously ill and that the demon cult was planning an all-out attack on the orthodox alliance, trying to decapitate it in a single battle.
How could that be real?
The demon cult should need at least a few more decades to prepare for an all-out war against the orthodox alliance and from what Ruyan told him, the chief strategist shouldn’t be ill.
"Are you sure about this information?" He asked, putting the document under the table.
"No, that’s what we’re here for." Yedu said, turning to Heidu.
"You managed to get in touch with one of the great elder’s servants, didn’t you? Did you find out anything?"
"Not much," the fattie shook his head.
"I tried using some soul techniques to scan his memory, but nothing worked, as if he had a blockage."
"Hm..." Yedu scratched his chin, wondering what to do.
"I also had contact with one of the targets." Qingyi said, placing the token he had received from Xue Mo on the table.
Yedu looked confused for a brief moment, but that confusion soon turned to shock as he grabbed the token.
Studying it carefully, he raised his face. "How did you get this? Do you know what this token represents?"
"No. All I know is that it was with Xue Mo’s personal servant.
After he angered the young lord and was killed, Xue Mo gave it to me, perhaps thinking I was a suitable servant.

"Ah... each of the demon cult leader’s children receives a personal servant who should accompany them throughout their lives; this is Xue Mo’s personal servant token, one of the most powerful items in the sect, having it makes you no less than a core disciple." Yedu spoke, still unable to believe his own eyes.
After a moment’s thought, he focused his eyes on Qingyi again. "You approach Xue Mo. Heidu and I will try to get close to the great guardian.
The chief strategist is almost always with the cult leader, so we’ll only approach him if necessary."
After chatting some more and settling some other less important matters, the trio split up.
Qingyi was thinking of going straight back to Ruyan’s mansion, but after thinking for a moment, he decided it was time to make a breakthrough.
It was a challenge to find a suitable cultivation room.
Almost all the cultivation rooms there only had demonic Qi, with the few offering totally pure Qi being absurdly expensive.
With pain in his heart, Qingyi paid the price before entering the cultivation room and calling up his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 19
Cultivation: Ninth Stage of the Crystalline Core Realm (500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 98 - Sword: 97 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Mortal-level three-colored spirit root (Lightning sword, fire, ice) (1,000,000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Mythical grade, 10,000,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Mythical grade, 10,000,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Lust points: 3,803,093]
After a moment’s hesitation, Qingyi clicked to improve his cultivation.
[Beginning advancement to the Nascent Soul Realm, the host must take care when building his Sea of Mind].
A notification from the system arrived and before Qingyi could even react, he was seized by intense pain, but this time in a different way.
His mind seemed to be torn from his body, everything becoming a messy blur as the space around him distorted.
When he realized it, he was naked, in a strange and totally dark place, his feet sinking up to his heels in water.
He couldn’t see anything, not even with his draconic eyes.
The reason he couldn’t see anything there was simple: there was nothing there.
That was his world of the mind; empty, untouched and ultimately non-existent.
"First, bring your dantian here." Ruxue’s sweet, mature voice echoed in Qingyi’s mind and he felt her appear beside him.
This time, she wasn’t in her human form, taking on the appearance of a strange being of light, floating a few meters off the ground, filled with a thunderous aura.
"That’s my real form, ignore it and focus on forming your sea of mind." Ruxue warned and Qingyi nodded.
Bringing up his dantian there... how the hell was he supposed to do that?
Qingyi asked, but no answer came.
He closed his eyes, thought, reflected and then just meditated.
After long hours, he felt his dantian respond, subtly, gently, almost non-existently.
It was only after a whole day that a firm response finally came and the world around him changed as a small orb of light left his abdomen, floating tenuously above the ground.
This orb completely swept away the darkness that surrounded him, a bluish sky appeared above his head as the orb shot towards the sky at an absurd speed, shining brighter than ever.
Soon, Qingyi found himself in a totally different place.
As far as his eyes could see, he saw an endless ocean, but one whose deepest places were barely twenty centimeters deep.
The sky above him was a deep blue, painted with ethereal white clouds and illuminated by his dantian, which shimmered above it all.
"Did I succeed?" Qingyi asked, turning to Ruxue who had now managed to take on her human form.
Her face was filled with shock, one hand covering her mouth as she stared into Qingyi’s sea of mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - Wasn’t that place too OP?
paragraphs: Seas of mind varied greatly in level.
In the mortal heavens, they rarely went beyond small dark dots of a few square meters and even in the celestial heavens, they were only a few tens of kilometers at most.
But Qingyi’s sea of mind was different, extending far beyond anything she had ever seen in her more than one hundred and fifty thousand years of life.
How could this be possible?
In the end, seas of the mind weren’t like worlds of the mind; they weren’t a physical representation of a world.
They were just places of meditation and training, a space to have direct contact with the dantian and the representation of one’s soul.
Whenever someone cultivates in the sea of mind, they are cultivating their own soul, not their body.
"Is everything all right?" Qingyi approached Ruxue, touching her beautiful face.
The spiritual beauty flinched, her face blushing deeply before she recovered.
"Y-yes, I’m fine." She regained her composure.
Honestly, when she thought of all Qingyi’s feats, his sea of mind didn’t even seem impressive.
The handsome young man just sighed heavily as he stretched, looking around him.
’So this is a sea of the mind... honestly, it’s a lot less than I expected.’ He thought.

Ruxue noticed the expression on Qingyi’s face and as if she could imagine what he was thinking, she said: "You still haven’t fully understood the value of this place, but you will soon. Return to your real body, it’s no different from leaving the world of the mind."
Hearing Ruxue’s words, Qingyi closed his eyes and when he opened them again, he was back in the real world.
[Your cultivation has increased! Ninth stage of the crystalline core realm -> First stage of the nascent soul realm].
Ignoring the system notification, Qingyi immediately studied his body.
His Qi reserves had increased tremendously, more than quadrupling, but apart from that, nothing much.
His physical strength had increased, but not by an impressive amount.
After long moments studying his body and everything around him, he finally noticed something.
There was a small counter on one of the walls of the room, marking the two days of use he had bought it for.
From the time Qingyi had spent advancing, this counter should have been at least halfway through, but it had barely moved.
"System... how long did my advance take?"
[14.4 minutes.]
That answer filled Qingyi’s face with shock, his mind working out some quick basic math before he understood.
"My sea of mind slows down time by 100 times..." He murmured as Ruxue appeared at his side.
"Yes. Seas of mind are mainly known for their ability to allow the cultivation of soul techniques, but they can also be used as a training ground.
Most Seas of mind only slow down the passage of time by a small fraction, so hardly any mortal heaven cultivators know about this use.
But it should become more common from the immortal sky onwards, where seas of mind that slow down time by five to ten times begin to appear.
I’ve never seen anyone with a sea of mind capable of slowing down the passage of time by 100 times, not even in the heavenly heavens."
Qingyi listened to Ruxue’s explanation in silence, his eyes filled with a subtle glow.
He returned to his sea of mind, his body floating a few meters off the ground as he stretched out his hand, a great flaming ethereal spear appearing in his grip.
Everything there was technically fake and existed only inside his head... Did that mean there was no Qi cost either?
The answer to Qingyi’s question came as soon as he threw the flame spear.
An explosion spread through the sea of his mind, a cloud of steam rising into the air and temporarily blinding him.
When he returned to the ground and his feet sank into the now boiling water, he could only sigh in amazement.
It was just like using the technique in the real world, but in a place where time passed 100 times slower and where his Qi reserves simply weren’t depleted.
Wasn’t that place too OP for him to master his techniques?
No... there had to be a cost.
"Ruxue, what do I lose if I use it too much?"

"In the short term? Nothing, but whenever you leave your sea of mind, all the accumulated mental fatigue from the slowed down time will hit your body at once, which can be quite uncomfortable." She explained, drawing a smile from Qingyi.
Yes... he could handle that cost.
Without hesitating any longer, the handsome young man started training, completely sweeping away any worries about time he had in his mind.
Qingyi spent a small fortune in lust points to buy the fourth form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art, working as hard as he could to synchronize it with the rest of his skills.

It was exhausting, but Qingyi managed to put those two hundred days to good use, focusing as much as possible on mastering his skills and even taking some time out to try to cultivate his soul, something he soon gave up doing.
He still didn’t have enough knowledge for that.
After months of training, Qingyi finally found himself ready to leave his sea of mind and return to the outside world.
The moment he felt himself back in his body, Qingyi immediately noticed his vision dimming and his body completely losing strength, overcome by a deep sleep.
’So that’s the accumulated fatigue Ruxue was talking about, it’s worse than I thought.’ Qingyi gritted his teeth, took a recovery pill and set off in the direction of the demon cult.
There, he immediately activated the concealment arrays in his robes as he made his way to Ruyan’s palace.
The little demoness was lying lazily on her bed, her voluptuous body covered by nothing but a thin, elegant nightgown.
She barely noticed when her bedroom door opened and a weight hit her large, soft breasts.
"Uh? Husband? How did you manage to get here without me noticing you? Is everything all right?" She asked confusedly.
Qingyi didn’t answer and just accepted the warm, comfortable embrace of her breasts, closing his eyes and falling asleep.
