"My sea of mind slows down time by 100 times..." He murmured as Ruxue appeared at his side.
"Yes.
Seas of mind are mainly known for their ability to allow the cultivation of soul techniques, but they can also be used as a training ground.
Most Seas of mind only slow down the passage of time by a small fraction, so hardly any mortal heaven cultivators know about this use.
But it should become more common from the immortal sky onwards, where seas of mind that slow down time by five to ten times begin to appear.
I’ve never seen anyone with a sea of mind capable of slowing down the passage of time by 100 times, not even in the heavenly heavens."
Qingyi listened to Ruxue’s explanation in silence, his eyes filled with a subtle glow.
He returned to his sea of mind, his body floating a few meters off the ground as he stretched out his hand, a great flaming ethereal spear appearing in his grip.
Everything there was technically fake and existed only inside his head...
Did that mean there was no Qi cost either?
The answer to Qingyi’s question came as soon as he threw the flame spear.
An explosion spread through the sea of his mind, a cloud of steam rising into the air and temporarily blinding him.
When he returned to the ground and his feet sank into the now boiling water, he could only sigh in amazement.
It was just like using the technique in the real world, but in a place where time passed 100 times slower and where his Qi reserves simply weren’t depleted.
Wasn’t that place too OP for him to master his techniques?
No... there had to be a cost.
"Ruxue, what do I lose if I use it too much?"
"In the short term?

Nothing, but whenever you leave your sea of mind, all the accumulated mental fatigue from the slowed down time will hit your body at once, which can be quite uncomfortable." She explained, drawing a smile from Qingyi.
Yes... he could handle that cost.
Without hesitating any longer, the handsome young man started training, completely sweeping away any worries about time he had in his mind.
Qingyi spent a small fortune in lust points to buy the fourth form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art, working as hard as he could to synchronize it with the rest of his skills.

It was exhausting, but Qingyi managed to put those two hundred days to good use, focusing as much as possible on mastering his skills and even taking some time out to try to cultivate his soul, something he soon gave up doing.
He still didn’t have enough knowledge for that.
After months of training, Qingyi finally found himself ready to leave his sea of mind and return to the outside world.
The moment he felt himself back in his body, Qingyi immediately noticed his vision dimming and his body completely losing strength, overcome by a deep sleep.
’So that’s the accumulated fatigue Ruxue was talking about, it’s worse than I thought.’ Qingyi gritted his teeth, took a recovery pill and set off in the direction of the demon cult.
There, he immediately activated the concealment arrays in his robes as he made his way to Ruyan’s palace.
The little demoness was lying lazily on her bed, her voluptuous body covered by nothing but a thin, elegant nightgown.
She barely noticed when her bedroom door opened and a weight hit her large, soft breasts.
"Uh?
Husband?
How did you manage to get here without me noticing you?
Is everything all right?" She asked confusedly.
Qingyi didn’t answer and just accepted the warm, comfortable embrace of her breasts, closing his eyes and falling asleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - I have a favor to ask of you.
paragraphs: "So... did hubby sleep well? Fufufu~~" Ruyan giggled softly when she noticed Qingyi’s eyes opening.
"What do you think?" Qingyi returned her smile as he stood up and looked outside.
He had slept for almost a whole day, which wasn’t so much when considering that he had almost two hundred days of accumulated mental fatigue.
But it had all been worth it.
Qingyi’s greatest weakness was still his lack of combat experience, especially when compared to experts with hundreds or thousands of years.
With those two hundred days, he had focused all his transcendental talent on solving this and the result was noticeable.
He had cut the time he spent using a skill by almost half, his battle senses becoming even sharper.
To be better than that, only if he were able to create a clone of himself in the seaf of the mind, something that, according to Ruxue, might be possible in the future.
That would make it much easier to train and gain real combat experience.
But now was not the time to think about that.
" Contacting your brother is part of my mission, I got his servant token." Qingyi spoke, those words making Ruyan’s eyes light up.
"Uh? Is the hubby going to kill him now? Blow his balls off?" She stood up excitedly.
"Hahaha... yes, I’m going to blow his balls off, but not now. I have a mission to complete first."
Ruyan looked a little disappointed, but soon recovered her sparkle.
Exchanging a passionate kiss with her one last time, Qingyi put the mask prepared by Heidu on his face and activated the concealment arrays of the three-bladed monarch set before leaving.
As the most talented son of the demon cult leader, Xue Mo naturally had his own private residence, a mansion no smaller in size than a small village.
Unlike Ruyan’s mansion, this one was completely surrounded by hundreds of guards, the weakest in the Nascent Soul Realm.
Another thousand servants looked after the mansion’s every need, ensuring that everything was perfect.
"Halt there, disciple, do you have permission to be here?" One of the guards protecting the main gate asked, stepping forward.
Qingyi immediately reached into his robes and pulled out a small token.
The moment they saw that token, the look on the guards’ faces changed completely and they greeted Qingyi with respect, allowing him to enter.
"You must be the young lord’s new personal servant." A middle-aged, elegant-looking servant approached Qingyi. "What’s your name?"
"It’s Zhao, miss, I don’t have a surname."
"I see, Mr. Zhao, come with me." The servant bowed before entering the mansion.
"Do you know why young Lord Xue Mo chose you to be his new personal servant?" The servant asked, looking at Qingyi out of the corner of her eye.
"Because I was lucky and because the last servant made a mistake."
"Exactly." The servant nodded, her thin lips curving into a soft smile.
"Then don’t make any mistakes." She stopped in front of a door, giving it a gentle knock to open it.
Inside, a room resembling a research office, shelves full of jars with tiny red worms taking over.
"What’s that?"
"Curiosity also kills." The servant answered Qingyi’s question.
"These are heartworms, they will lodge in your heart after you eat it. Any thought of betrayal and the worm will devour your heart and destroy you from the inside."
Qingyi shuddered at those words.
As an avid reader of Xianxia novels in his past life, he naturally knew about those worms.
But the thought of having one inside his own chest immediately made him rethink his life choices.
[The host has nothing to fear, his bloodline will destroy the worm as soon as it enters his body]
The system’s words made him relax a little, but not completely.
He still had to swallow that disgusting thing.
The servant took one of the jars, opened it and took out the worm.
"Open your mouth," she ordered as the little creature squirmed in her fingers.
Qingyi closed his eyes.
Was there still time to abandon the mission? Was riding on Khaedryss, grabbing Ruyan and getting the hell out of there an option?
That was exactly what Qingyi wanted to do.
Unfortunately, the servant didn’t seem to be very patient.
Grabbing Qingyi’s cheeks, she shoved the worm into his mouth.
The handsome young man had to fight the urge to vomit, his body seized by slight spasms as the creature made its way into his viscera.
Fortunately, this didn’t last long.
His draconic Qi soon began to move, burning the heartworm to pieces.
The servant just made sure that Qingyi had swallowed everything before turning away. "Come with me, I’ll take you to young lord Xue Mo."
The handsome young man only coughed a few times before, with trembling steps, accompanying her to one of the courtyards of the mansion, where two men could be seen sitting.
One of these was the young Lord Xue Mo, his handsome, youthful face bearing a big smile as he chatted with another man.
This was an obese man, easily over two hundred kilos of pure fat, devouring a bottle of wine as if he were drinking a glass of cold, refreshing water.
He was the grand elder of the demon cult, Xue Mo’s uncle.
"Ah... this is good, young Lord Xue Mo, hahaha! Truly blessed by the most divine heavenly demon!" The great elder laughed, letting out a great burp as he placed the wine on the table between them.
"But you didn’t call me here just to spoil me with wine of this quality, did you?"
"Indeed not, uncle, I have a favor to ask of you." Xue Mo spoke awkwardly, pulling out another bottle of wine and handing it to his uncle.
"Speak up, nephew, we’re family. Don’t be ashamed."

Despite those words, Xue Mo still hesitated for a brief moment before finally speaking, "I’m going on a hunt in the forbidden forest, when I get back from that hunt, I plan to ask my father to make Ruyan my concubine, I want uncle’s support in this matter."

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - She’s your sister.
paragraphs: The smile on the grand old man’s face suddenly disappeared.
After a moment of silence, he opened his mouth. "She’s your sister."

"Half sister. And you know Dad well, do you really think he cares about that sort of thing? She’s just a woman, the kind you’d find in any brothel." Xue Mo replied, drawing a defeated sigh from his uncle.
"You seem rather obsessed with a woman you can find in any brothel." The grand elder stood up, giving his plump belly a gentle slap.
"But I can’t deny her beauty, no one can. Even among her father’s other daughters, she is incomparable.
If we were to combine her beauty and her newly discovered talent, I doubt very much that you’d find a better woman in the whole cult."
"Uncle’s not wrong, hahaha," Xue Mo laughed. "But I need confirmation, will you help me with that?"
"Your father is in closed-door cultivation right now and the chief strategist’s condition has worsened even more. I’ll talk to him as soon as I get a chance." Xue Mo’s uncle said.
Without further ado, he bade his nephew farewell before leaving.
Xue Mo just sighed heavily as he settled into his chair, a big smile taking over his face.
He could already feel that woman just a few centimeters from his grasp, and that put him in a very good mood.
"Is everything all right?" He turned his face towards the servant and Qingyi, who were listening attentively.
The handsome young man was having to hold on with all his might not to throw himself down Xue Mo’s throat right then and there, but he knew it wasn’t the time.
"Yes, young lord." The servant bowed respectfully, as did Qingyi.
"Good." Xue Mo stood up, approached Qingyi and slapped him hard on the shoulder.
"I see you’ve made a breakthrough, congratulations. We’re going on a hunt to the forbidden forest in about a week, so prepare well.
Without even giving Qingyi time to reply, Xue Mo left.

"The young master seems to be happy, be grateful for that. You don’t want to be around when he’s angry." The maid turned around, watching Qingyi, who just nodded before being taken to his room and then released to do whatever he wanted.
He had only been there a short time, but he had already learned many things.
Firstly, the confirmation that Xue Mo was indeed a pig begging for his blade.
Something he was obviously already sure of.
Secondly, confirmation that the chief strategist of the demon cult was indeed seriously ill.
This was obviously very important information for the entire orthodox alliance, but it barely crossed Qingyi’s mind.
What he really needed was to make sure Ruyan was all right and to do that, he needed to act before Xue Mo finished his hunt.
"This isn’t going to be easy..." Qingyi gritted his teeth.

When he was at the peak of the crystalline core realm, he could already beat weaker cultivators from the peak of the nascent soul realm, but he didn’t dare believe that this breakthrough to the nascent soul realm would change much for him.
Rebirth realm cultivators were very different from nascent soul realm cultivators; their bodies underwent a complete rebirth, not unlike the bodies of transcendents.
Their power exploded to such a level that a single Rebirth realm cultivator probably had the power to kill hundreds of Nascent Soul realm cultivators.
Naturally, such a level wasn’t easy to reach, even considering Qingyi’s lineage.
"Ah... I should have asked for a duel with Tang Biyue. Qingyi spoke, his eyes narrowing as he let out a weary sigh.
He really needed to know more about the true power of a Rebirth realm cultivator.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have time for that right now.
Sitting cross-legged on his bed, Qingyi began to cultivate.
The next week was a busy one for him; he had to receive personal lessons from the servant master for at least an hour a day.
Those lessons were like torture for Qingyi, but he endured the six days of suffering before the day of young master Xue Mo’s hunt.
On the last day of the week, he activated the concealment arrays of the three-bladed monarch set and set off, stopping in a secluded place and clicking to improve his cultivation.
Five hundred and fifty thousand lust points were immediately wiped from his balance of lust points as his body was seized by a mild pain, his sea of mind shuddering slightly.
When this pain was completely replaced by a strange refreshment, Qingyi set off in the direction of Ruyan’s mansion.
This time, the demonic beauty was cultivating in her private cultivation room, totally unaware of the world around her.
Realizing this, Qingyi did nothing to disturb her, just sitting in the corner waiting until he heard the loud rocky creak of the cultivation room door opening.

"Husband!" Ruyan’s beautiful red eyes sparkled as she threw herself into Qingyi’s arms. "Did you remember me? What did that fat, tight little pussy do to deserve punishment from the husband this time?" She asked mischievously.
She seemed more excited than anything at the idea of punishment.
"Nothing," Qingyi gave a muffled giggle, observing the disappointed and cute expression that took over Ruyan’s face.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t appreciate that cuteness for long, and was soon forced to put on a serious expression.
"Your brother is going on a hunt in the forbidden forest, I plan to kill him there," he explained.

"Oh, finally! How is the husband going to kill that faggot? Are you really going to blow his balls off? I highly recommend this method! Even if you fail to kill him, I’m sure he’ll wish he was dead!" Ruyan said excitedly.
"Ah... why are you so obsessed with blowing off his balls?"
"hm... Because I am!"
"That’s... fair enough." Qingyi shook his head in defeat, deciding that there was no point in trying to fight Ruyan’s logic.
As long as it made her happy, he was happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - Make it slow and painful
paragraphs: Soon after settling everything with Ruyan, Qingyi placed her in Ruxue’s mind world before heading back towards the mansion of the cult’s young lord.
Qingyi spent the night cultivating, stabilizing his cultivation base before heading out into the courtyard of the mansion early in the morning.
A small caravan had been prepared, with supplies for a hunt that would last for months, but he knew full well that this hunt wouldn’t last that long.
The Forbidden Forest, as its name implied, was a forbidden zone in the Deadlands.

Even cultivators of the Rebirth Realm could encounter difficulties there, with reports even of the existence of a mythical beast from the Transcendence Realm, from the time before the Great Demon War.

Qingyi didn’t know much about this beast, not beyond the fact that it was a giant fox with a pure white coat, a being that had battled the leader of the demon cult many times over the last few thousand years.
Since it hadn’t shown itself for centuries, everyone was pretty sure it was dead.
After thinking for another brief moment, Qingyi shifted his gaze to Xue Mo, who was now surrounded by three other individuals with very distinct shapes.
A woman of little beauty but a voluptuous body, a large, burly man and finally, a small, thin young man, who barely looked more than sixteen years old.
The only thing that united them were their blood-red eyes, black hair and sharp horns.
"Oh... is this your new servant, big brother? He looks..." The woman stopped her own words, thinking of what word would be adequate to describe Qingyi’s current form. "Acceptable."
"He hasn’t proven himself yet, but I’m sure he will." Xue Mo said as he turned around.
"Thank you for your words, young master Xue Mo, I promise not to let you down." Qingyi bowed respectfully, but the response he received was not what he expected.
"I didn’t give you permission to call my name, worm." Xue Mo stopped his steps, casting a sidelong glance at Qingyi as he spat on the ground.
He was no longer in a good mood.
The handsome young man just stood there, unable to suppress the bitterness in his heart.
He couldn’t wait to finally be able to tear that son of a bitch apart.
’Ah... patience, just a little longer.’ He sighed internally, narrowing his eyes towards Xue Mo’s other brothers.
They were all in the realm of rebirth, but Qingyi didn’t even take them into account.
They had no lineage or constitution, their power was mediocre, as was their foundation; built with expensive resources, not effort and talent.
Qingyi would feel very disappointed if he needed more than a single blow to get rid of the four of them, even though they could become problematic figures if they fought side by side with Xue Mo.
It wasn’t long before the caravan set off towards the forbidden forest.
Qingyi was quite surprised to see Fatty Heidu join the caravan, seeming to use some kind of concealment technique to avoid being noticed as he mingled with the other servants.
Qingyi wanted to approach him to ask how things were going, but decided to avoid suspicion and just followed Xue Mo silently.
The journey lasted about two weeks, another two days being used to find a suitable place for hunting, where a large camp was set up, incense sticks to summon spirit beasts placed around it.
Qingyi soon found himself with young master Xue Mo and the other sons of the demon cult leader, watching the horizon animatedly from under a flying platform.

"Looks like you’re out of luck this time, Xue Mo, there don’t seem to be any beasts within hundreds of kilometers, hahaha." The burly man laughed as he opened a bottle of liquor, downing it in a single gulp.
"You just don’t have the patience, brother." Xue Mo smiled coldly, his eyes focusing on a small cloud of dust on the horizon.
"A corrupt scarlet-haired boar... and a very big one." The voluptuous woman spoke, her red eyes glowing softly.
"And it seems to be chasing someone." The youngest of the brothers commented, but no one there cared.
They were more interested in the beast.

"First stage of the rebirth realm, it’ll be a good appetizer." Young master Xue Mo laughed as his body was launched into the air, quickly breaking the sound barrier and cutting through the distance of kilometers in a few seconds.
The moment it sensed Xue Mo’s Qi, the beast stopped its pursuit of what appeared to be a group of merchants, looking up.
"Die, worm." Xue Mo drew his sword, a sickly crimson aura taking over his blade as his body collapsed, spinning in the air and cutting everything around him.
An explosion ripped through the entire forbidden forest, a crater hundreds of meters across opening up as a cloud of dust rose to cloud height.
The shockwave from the attack was so powerful that it knocked down more trees from kilometers away, sweeping away the forest’s most fragile vegetation.
From this cloud of dust, the figure of young master Xue Mo rose, carrying the decapitated head of the spirit beast.
His cold, contemptuous eyes soon focused on the panting merchants, who looked at him with intense gratitude.
But this gratitude didn’t last long, the perception of the patterns on the clothes Xue Mo was wearing quickly sweeping that away.
That was a demon lord’s son!
The leader of the group of merchants gathered his courage before stepping forward. "Y-young master, we were just taking a shortcut and ended up getting lost, please forgive this little-"
"This is the demon cult’s private hunting zone, no one is allowed to hunt here apart from us. To be here, you must be an illegal hunter." Xue Mo interrupted the merchant.
"N-no, not at all, we’re just merchants taking a shortcut, we would never dare to hunt illegally on the cult’s land!" The merchant tried to explain himself, but Xue Mo didn’t care.

Turning to Qingyi who was approaching with his other brothers, Xue Mo smiled.
"Show your worth to these vermin, servant. You have spiritual roots of fire and ice, right? Make it slow and painful, kill the children first, make sure the adults are watching." He ordered Qingyi.

A small caravan had been prepared, with supplies for a hunt that would last for months, but he knew full well that this hunt wouldn’t last that long.
The Forbidden Forest, as its name implied, was a forbidden zone in the Deadlands.

Even cultivators of the Rebirth Realm could encounter difficulties there, with reports even of the existence of a mythical beast from the Transcendence Realm, from the time before the Great Demon War.

Qingyi didn’t know much about this beast, not beyond the fact that it was a giant fox with a pure white coat, a being that had battled the leader of the demon cult many times over the last few thousand years.

After thinking for another brief moment, Qingyi shifted his gaze to Xue Mo, who was now surrounded by three other individuals with very distinct shapes.

The only thing that united them were their blood-red eyes, black hair and sharp horns.

He couldn’t wait to finally be able to tear that son of a bitch apart.

The moment it sensed Xue Mo’s Qi, the beast stopped its pursuit of what appeared to be a group of merchants, looking up.
"Die, worm." Xue Mo drew his sword, a sickly crimson aura taking over his blade as his body collapsed, spinning in the air and cutting everything around him.
An explosion ripped through the entire forbidden forest, a crater hundreds of meters across opening up as a cloud of dust rose to cloud height.
The shockwave from the attack was so powerful that it knocked down more trees from kilometers away, sweeping away the forest’s most fragile vegetation.
From this cloud of dust, the figure of young master Xue Mo rose, carrying the decapitated head of the spirit beast.
His cold, contemptuous eyes soon focused on the panting merchants, who looked at him with intense gratitude.
But this gratitude didn’t last long, the perception of the patterns on the clothes Xue Mo was wearing quickly sweeping that away.
That was a demon lord’s son!

"This is the demon cult’s private hunting zone, no one is allowed to hunt here apart from us.
To be here, you must be an illegal hunter." Xue Mo interrupted the merchant.

Make it slow and painful, kill the children first, make sure the adults are watching." He ordered Qingyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - How could anyone be so unnecessarily cruel?
paragraphs: Qingyi suddenly stopped, closing his eyes and controlling the anger burning in his heart.
He didn’t want to be a hypocrite. He had done cruel things before, he had tortured men to the point of madness.
But he had never intentionally hurt anyone who hadn’t put his life or the lives of his wives at risk.
He had never killed an innocent by choice.
But for Xue Mo, killing those innocent people was little different from crushing an insect.
How could anyone be so unnecessarily cruel?
"Oh... he’s hesitating! Looks like your servant isn’t so good, hahaha!" The voluptuous woman laughed, approaching Qingyi and ignoring Xue Mo’s bitter face.
She reached out her hand, trying to grab him, but her movement stopped at the last moment.
Her eyes widened and a splash of blood hit her face.
Her other siblings had the exact same look of shock as their sister’s severed hand fell to the ground.
That had been a surprise attack and she hadn’t even had time to defend herself with her Qi, but even so, it shouldn’t have happened.
The sword of any other cultivator of Qingyi’s level would have bounced off her skin or, in the worst case, stopped before it even reached the bone.
How sharp was that blade?

"AH! You son of a bitch! I will-" The voluptuous woman’s words were interrupted when the heaven-defying thunder sword tore through her lips and jaw, surrounded by a thunderous aura covered in silver threads of sword Qi.
The blade broke through the inside of her throat, coming out the back of her head with a spray of crimson blood.
Qingyi had expected a lot of reactions from Xue Mo, but not the one she got.
"Ugh... killed by a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator. Trash." The young lord spat on the corpse, waving to his brothers still in shock. "What are you waiting for, get rid of that little shit."
The two exchanged glances, hesitating for a brief moment before advancing towards Qingyi.
’Good... that makes things a lot easier.’ Qingyi smiled as he took a defensive stance, watching the two advance towards him.
As children of the demon lord, they naturally had access to better techniques, something that became very clear when they activated their movement techniques.
Qingyi briefly lost sight of them, only being able to see them clearly when he activated his draconic eyes.
At that moment, they were already upon him, their weapons covered in demonic Qi as they sliced through the air.
The handsome young man barely managed to dodge as the two blades passed inches from his face.
He activated the lightning steps, retreating more than a hundred meters in the blink of an eye.
The shockwave from the brothers’ joint attack reached him immediately afterwards, causing his clothes to flutter.
"I’ll kill you for touching our sister, you insolent worm!" The burly brother roared, his great sword filled with a demonic aura as he raised it over his head.
"Don’t let your guard down, idiot, this is no simple enemy!" The smallest of the brothers spoke, but his words were unnecessary.
Deciding it was time to put an end to it, Qingyi touched his draconic Qi, using his lineage projection.
Xue Mo seemed uninterested in the battle, being more annoyed at having to change his personal servant again than at the fact that his sister had just died.
Even the fact that that servant had lightning sword Qi along with fire and ice Qi caused him little shock.
But all that disinterest vanished the moment he noticed the change in Qingyi’s body, his blood-red eyes focused on the black figure that appeared behind the handsome young man’s body.
It was a dragon; or rather, the head of a dragon. Big enough to swallow a small house, each sharp fang easily the size of a man.
Xue Mo trembled under the penetrating gaze of that purple-eyed beast, something that immediately filled him with shock.
’I-I’m afraid?’ Xue Mo looked at his own hands, feeling the lineage of the celestial demon inside him.
No... It wasn’t just him who was trembling.
His bloodline was trembling!
It was being suppressed!
The thought immediately made his heart sink.
How could that be possible?
Qingyi was completely oblivious to Xue Mo’s thoughts, focused on the other two brothers who had been completely suppressed by the image of the black dragon on their backs.
"Ready to die?" Qingyi flashed a broad, strangely gentle smile, as if he were meeting old friends, not preparing for a massacre.
Out of the corner of his eye, he could see the merchants fleeing.
From the distance they were already, he could fight at full strength without the danger of them falling into the crossfire.
"You bastard!" The burly man finally mustered the strength to bring his blade down in a descending attack, a sea of demonic flames flying towards Qingyi, consuming everything around him.
The handsome young man was undeterred, readying his sword.
With a soft sigh, he activated the lightning steps, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art.
The corpulent man’s already unstable Qi shattered under Qingyi’s attack, his eyes filling with terror as the handsome young man’s blade tore through his chest.

Without wasting a single moment, Qingyi struck again, using the second form of the Tempest Monarch sword art against the other brother, whose decapitated body soon fell to the ground with a deafening thud.
Soon, only Qingyi and Xue Mo remained.
’Ruxue, are you sure your fragment is with him?’ Qingyi asked, just to confirm.
"Yes," Ruxue replied.
"You..." Xue Mo took a step forward while gripping the handle of his sword.
A sharp hiss echoed as the crimson blade was revealed, shimmering softly.
"Who the hell are you?" Xue Mo growled, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
"I..." Qingyi seemed to think for a brief moment before grabbing his mask and pulling it off.
His face of transcendental beauty soon revealed itself, the strands of demonic Qi in his Qi disappearing completely.
"I’m Long Qingyi, your sister’s man. She asked me to deal with a disgusting, incestuous pig."

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - Get him, hubby!
paragraphs: Qingyi’s words weren’t much, but they were enough to completely destabilize Xue Mo.
"Don’t you dare put my sister’s name in your mouth, you filthy worm!" The demon cult’s young lord roared, his eyes filled with enough hatred to melt steel.
Without holding back, Xue Mo swung his blade in a horizontal slash.
Qingyi raised the heaven-defying thunder sword defensively, but soon regretted not dodging.
It was like being hit by a truck at top speed; his feet were knocked off the ground and his arms shook as he was catapulted backwards.
His body tore through the dense vegetation, his back breaking through thick trunks like toothpicks, leaving a trail of destruction.
He only came to a stop after almost five hundred meters, sinking his heaven-defying thunder sword into the ground for support.
Raising his gaze, he saw Xue Mo whose body had already changed completely, a crimson aura filled with darkness spreading dozens of meters above him.
From this aura, a male figure formed, his eyes blood red, black horns rising from his bald head, his presence powerful and sickly enough to make the plants around him die.
Qingyi felt nothing from that lineage.
Even with the difference in cultivation, it was simply too far from being comparable to the blood of the dragon god of corruption.
All it managed to do was lessen the lineage suppression that Xue Mo was feeling.
"So that’s the heavenly demon?... Quite disappointing." Qingyi smiled.
"SHUT UP, INSECT!" Xue Mo shouted as he advanced, his crimson blade breaking through the air with frightening speed.
Qingyi didn’t dare let his guard down as a blade of demonic Qi formed in the air, flying towards him.
Stepping hard on the ground, a wall of ice formed in front of him, more than ten meters thick and rising almost thirty meters high.
Even so, it did little to stop Xue Mo’s blow, only slightly reducing its power before shattering with a crystalline crash.
Although the effect was small, Qingyi didn’t care.
His body was covered in black scales, his lightning sword aura shining with more power than ever as he attacked, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch sword art.
When the attacks met, the world around them seemed to completely lose color.
A shockwave capable of bursting eardrums from kilometers away spread through the Forbidden Forest as the world around them shattered into pieces.
’where does this son of a bitch get so much strength?’ Qingyi gritted his teeth, feeling his muscles scream in agony.
His bloodline was much more powerful than Xue Mo’s, but clearly not powerful enough to overcome the difference in cultivation.
The moment he managed to fend off Xue Mo’s blow, Qingyi found himself having to retreat another hundred meters.
"Get him, hubby! Blow his balls off and make him regret being born!" Ruyan’s voice echoed in Qingyi’s mind; she seemed to be watching the battle quite excitedly.
That immediately filled Qingyi with power. He couldn’t be humiliated in front of his women, right?
With a soft grunt, he propelled himself into the air, raising his hand.
He wondered - how many of his flaming spears would Xue Mo be able to withstand? Would he be able to reach the ninth and most powerful of the spears?
’There’s only one way to find out...’ Qingyi muttered as a sea of flames spread from his hands, forming the figure of a long, ethereal spear, its crimson handle covered in dancing flames.
"What trick do you plan to use now, worm? Just hand over your life and I promise I’ll only torture you for a single eternity! Maybe I’ll even give your soul a rest when you die." Xue Mo said.
Qingyi ignored those provocations, keeping a smile on his face. "Do you know what your sister sounds like when I sink my cock into her pussy? What she calls me when I fuck her?"
"SILENCE!" Xue Mo roared, his eyes filled with nothing but mad fury. "You’ll regret putting my little sister’s name in your filthy mouth!"
"Let’s see if I will."
Without hesitating any longer, Qingyi finally threw his first spear, which didn’t even have the strength to reach Xue Mo, being shattered by his demonic Qi in mid-air.
"Is that all? Where do you think you’re going with this pathetic display? You filthy servant!" Xue Mo cursed, but was soon forced to swallow his words as a second spear formed in Qingyi’s hands.
It was much more powerful than the previous one, much more intense.

This time, he had to defend himself seriously, forming a Qi barrier around himself and barely stopping Qingyi’s spear a few meters away from him, his robes fluttering as it exploded in a cloud of fire.
On the third strike, he finally realized something was wrong, his eyes shining with a hint of anxiety as he watched Qingyi’s black-scaled body.
"I can do it too!" Xue Mo leapt into the air, his body also changing.
His horns almost doubled in size, his eyes taking on a feline shape as the muscles in his body exploded.
His legs seemed to take on the form of a goat’s legs, sharp nails rising from his hands as he reached a height of more than three meters.
’Is that something similar to the black dragon’s scales?’ Qingyi wondered.
For the first time since the fight began, he felt a hint of real danger, but that didn’t discourage him.
It had been a long time since he had bled.
Basically all his enemies were just ants that he could blow up with a single attack.
Xue Mo had been the first worthy enemy Qingyi had fought in months and he wouldn’t waste that chance.
He would get as much out of that fight as possible!
Without hesitating any longer, Qingyi launched the third flame spear.
At the same time, the air around Xue Mo changed as he raised his hand, his sword glowing with intense demonic Qi.
"You die here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - Don’t think you’re going to die that easily.
paragraphs: Xue Mo raised his large demonic hand, grabbing the spear thrown by Qingyi.
An explosion of flames engulfed his body and he was forced back a few meters, a cloud of black smoke rising from the palm where the flaming spear had hit him.
Turning his hand, Xue Mo examined his skin which had now taken on a black hue, covered in pulsating red marks.
Between these marks, a small, sharp cut leaked fiery blue blood.
Qingyi had just wounded him in his most perfect form... A form second only to his father’s.
How could this be possible?
Xue Mo’s heart was filled with various emotions, but they all culminated in one - the purest and most uncontrollable rage.
The Qi around his demonic body exploded as he hit the ground, his hooves sinking into the mud that covered that part of the forest as he picked up momentum.
Qingyi just watched coldly, calling for the fourth spear.
It was getting dangerous and the amount of Qi used with each spear was noticeable in his dantian, but that didn’t worry him.
He still had almost three million lust points, much more than enough to solve the problem easily if necessary.
Xue Mo advanced, his blade growing to fit the new size of his body, tearing through the air and leaving a crimson trail behind.
Qingyi launched the fourth flaming spear before readying the heaven-defying thunder sword.
The spear struck Xue Mo’s left arm, tearing through his blackened flesh, its advance ceasing in a thunderous explosion as it finally reached the bone.
Even so, Xue Mo didn’t flinch.
The pain was erased by hatred as his roar spread through the forbidden forest.
’Ah... persistent son of a bitch. Qingyi gritted his teeth as he prepared the heaven-defying thunder sword.
He had learned the fourth form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art, but had yet to use it in real combat.
Naturally, he was curious.
His eyes glowed a deep purple, a thunderous aura flowing through his silver- purplish blade, making the air around him boil.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - Pray that he wakes up in a month.
paragraphs: The palace of the leader of the demonic cult was an incomparable place, surrounded by crimson rivers and boiling gas geysers.
Throughout a region of more than a hundred kilometers, demonic beasts from the realm of rebirth patrolled.
The last ten kilometers were patrolled directly by the demon lord’s personal guard, the Crimson Guard.
In a secluded room in the depths of this palace was the clinic of the celestial demon doctor.
He was an old man with a kind face and calm steps, with a long, well-kept gray beard.
"Ugh... that damned Tang patriarch!" The demon cult leader gritted his teeth as he sat on a cold steel platform, his powerful body revealing horrible wounds.
They were like a thousand tiny needles covering his body, forming purple circles where they had been lodged.

"You were hasty, little Mochen, it’s not just because I said that perhaps the Tang patriarch had a solution to the chief strategist’s problem that you should advance on the Tang family without having any self control."
The demon doctor spoke, placing acupuncture needles around each of the poisonous marks on Mochen’s body.
This was the poison that came from another transcendent; naturally, it was difficult to get rid of it, even for Mochen.
Only the demon doctor was capable of dealing with that kind of injury.
Despite the doctor’s apparently disrespectful words, Mochen didn’t care.
He would kill anyone else who dared to refer to him like that, even his son. But there were two exceptions.
The demon doctor was one of them, while the other...
Mochen looked at the other steel platform next to him, where a man with noble features and a gentle smile was lying, also receiving the demon master’s treatments.
This man was the chief strategist of the demonic cult, a genius of diplomacy and strategy and above all, Mochen’s personal friend.
Unfortunately, his life was running out and, after an assassination attempt, he ended up in that state, between life and death.
"How much longer do you think he’ll last?" Mochen asked, a little worry creeping into his voice.
He had lost his son a month ago, had been betrayed by one of his daughters, but none of that made him worry.
They were disposable things that he could give birth to at any time.
But the chief strategist was different.
"If he doesn’t wake up in a month... I truly doubt I’ll be able to keep him alive any longer.
"A month..." Mochen raised his aged but dignified face, the black, broken horns on his head shining next to his eyes.
"Fucking orthodox hypocrites... Pray that he wakes up in a month."
Mochen didn’t know who had ambushed the chief strategist.
It could be some internal faction of his cult, some mysterious external power or the Orthodox alliance itself.
But whoever it was, the world would bleed for his friend’s death.
In the Orthodox alliance, things weren’t looking good either.
Any member of the alliance could only leave the territory with special permission.
Anyone who left without this permission and without a valid justification ran the risk of being investigated as a traitor.
Against this scenery, Qingyi cut through the skies of the orthodox alliance, landing in the center of the zone controlled by the snake battalion, entering the administrative center.
"Where’s Tang Biyue?" Qingyi asked the attendant, who immediately recognized him.
"I beg your pardon, young master Qingyi, but I have no information about Lady Tang Biyue. Only the council of elders can help you with that," the attendant replied respectfully as she bowed.
"Shit..." Qingyi grunted, preparing to leave the building when he heard a male voice, coming from a noble and dignified-looking man, stroking his well-groomed white beard.
"Greetings, young man. Are you going to the council palace? I can accompany you if you like."
Qingyi watched the man for a brief moment.
He was an outside visitor, at the peak of the rebirth realm, something made clear by the small badge on his chest.
"Zhao Wuhen... Where have I heard that name before?" Qingyi murmured, a gleam of realization taking over his face.
That man was the great elder of the Zhao family, Yulie’s father, whom he had killed some time ago.
"Do you know me?" Qingyi asked.
"Yes, I do." Wuhen kept a calm smile on his face. "Why don’t we talk on the way? Without being able to fly, it’s a long way to the council."
Without even waiting for an answer from Qingyi, Wuhen started walking.
The handsome young man thought for a moment, but in the end just followed him.
After a moment of silence, Qingyi said, "I killed your son."
"Yes, you did." Wuhen nodded.
"Aren’t you angry?"
"I was angry for a few minutes; losing a son is still losing a son. But he deserved it. I read the report prepared by that explosive little woman, Rongyan.
I couldn’t deal with the shame of having a son who had worked with the demon cult to kill a fellow disciple."
"That..." Qingyi paused for a moment, not used to receiving that kind of response.
He really expected Wuhen to throw himself on his sword the first chance he got, begging to die.
That was the usual behavior of damned old men and he rarely saw it any different.
"It makes sense," Qingyi bowed his head in defeat.
Men like Wuhen were dangerous, he knew that well.
"I’m glad you understand. I asked for you at the alliance, they said you were on a mission. You probably don’t know that the guardian has ordered the sect leader’s house arrest, do you?"
Wuhen commented, watching Qingyi’s face fill with shock.
"They say she’s been controlled by an immortal heaven being for over twenty-nine years, originating from the rift that occurred in the heavens a few decades ago. Truly frightening."
Qingyi just listened in silence.
As a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator, his mind was naturally much faster than any mortal mind, but that speed wasn’t even necessary for him to reach a conclusion.
Elize had arrived in that world when she was 6 years old; she’s 35 now, so that was 29 years ago.
The rift also took place around 29 years ago, just as the sect leader created the secret realm of the divine beast 28 years ago, probably putting Khaedryss inside.
It was hard not to think that they had some connection.

But Wuhen had earned his respect.
He would live a long life if he continued this path.
Sighing wearily, Qingyi entered the palace of the council of elders.
The atmosphere was obviously not pleasant.
Hundreds of guards protected the entire main hall, while a few elders chatted in its center.
One of them looked over his shoulder, noticing Qingyi.
"Greetings, elder." Qingyi bowed, drawing a smile from the old man.
"Oh... junior Qingyi, Yedu has already sent us a report on your mission! Tell me, did you really kill the heir to the demon cult?" The elder asked.
Those words immediately provoked gasps of shock from everyone there.
Especially from a tall man with golden eyes and beauty only slightly inferior to Qingyi.
It was the leader of the dragon battalion, Tianyu.
"Impossible!" He exclaimed, jumping down from the staircase connected to the central hall.
His body landed in front of Qingyi, the fine marble beneath his feet cracking.
"You didn’t beat that bastard! Even I’m no match for him!" Tianyu exclaimed, checking Qingyi’s cultivation.
Of course, seeing how much and how quickly Qingyi had evolved made his heart tremble, but he attributed it all to luck, nothing more.

"Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have business with my battalion leader, Tang Biyue." Qingyi took a step to the side, but Tianyu blocked in front of him.
"Do you really think she’ll want to meet you? She didn’t even allow me to meet her, what makes you think that-" Before Tianyu had even finished his sentence, a cold voice interrupted him.
"Young master Qingyi, Lady Tang requests that you go up to the war council room." The owner of that voice was an elite guard from the Tang family.
He was dressed in long black leather robes encrusted with steel plates, his face covered by a dark black mask.
He was one of the Tang family patriarch’s personal guards, but in the current situation, he was assigned to protect possible heirs.

"Accept if you have the courage."

He closed his eyes.
He calmed his breathing.

The figure of a black dragon appeared on his back, its power no less than that of Tianyu.
Naturally its size had been reduced since they were in an enclosed space, but its presence was still oppressive.
"If you wish to die such a death in front of one of your juniors, very well, I will grant it to you."
"I don’t accept that, neither does the council of elders!" The elder stepped forward, placing himself between the two and releasing his Rebirth Realm Qi, trying to push them apart.

"Do you wish to fight to the death? Very well. I will grant you that chance and authorize this duel," Yanxiao declared.

paragraphs: News of what had happened in the palace of the council of elders spread like wildfire.
Unlike the outer region of the Blue Moon Continent, where Qingyi was already very well known for his achievements and talent, his name in the Orthodox Alliance was basically non-existent.
A rookie who impressed all the squad leaders and won first place during the selection.
These achievements were quickly forgotten amid the stressful routine of the alliance’s warriors.
But now that had changed.

His squad leader’s report stated that he had killed the current heir to the leader of the demon cult in a one-on-one fight. Something that was quickly confirmed by reports from other spies in the demon cult.
That alone would have raised his prestige to incomparable levels, but it didn’t cause as much shock as the news that followed.
Tianyu had challenged Qingyi to a duel to the death, and not only had Qingyi accepted this duel, but Yanxiao himself, the guardian of Qingyi’s origin sect, had given permission for it to happen.
With that, Qingyi’s fame exploded through the roof, his name on the lips of every orthodox warrior on every street corner.
"Ah... I should have taken another route..." Qingyi lowered his head, feeling intense stares focus on him as he walked through the orthodox alliance.
It sure was uncomfortable when his wives weren’t there for him to brag about what an amazing husband they had.
With a weary sigh, he hurried on, arriving in an area completely separate from the orthodox alliance; a cluster of luxurious pavilions protected by powerful defensive formations.
That place was home to the residences of the transcendents who founded the orthodox alliance.
Without hesitation, Qingyi walked down the wide street that separated these many pavilions, arriving in front of a large mansion with flaming red walls.
Through the huge double doors, clearly not made for humans, Qingyi could see a figure lying on a gigantic cushion, watching him with interest.
"It took longer than I expected." Yanxiao’s feline body rose, his large, sharp claws being briefly revealed as he stretched.
"Greetings, guardian. May I ask what you wish with me?" Qingyi asked, bowing and respectfully clasping his fists together.
The gentle smile on Yanxiao’s huge face suddenly disappeared as he sensed Qingyi’s cultivation.
The day before, Qingyi was at the eighth stage of the Nascent Soul Realm, but now, he was already a single step away from the Rebirth Realm.
Even seeing it with his own eyes, Yanxiao still found it difficult to understand Qingyi.
"Qingyi."
"Yes, Guardian?"
"How long have you been cultivating?"
That question made Qingyi shudder slightly, thinking of an answer.
After a moment’s hesitation, he decided to tell the truth.
He was in no position to lie about his talent, not when he had proven it so many times.
"My master started training me when I was 10, but I only embarked on my cultivation journey for good a little less than two years ago."
"Less than two years..." Yanxiao whispered. "Qingyi, do you know what the talent curve is?" The tiger turned its face, its feline eyes focusing on the horizon.
"No, guardian."
Sighing, Yanxiao explained: "The talent curve is what defines a cultivator’s limit and how quickly a they reaches their limit, it’s steeper at first, but then it starts to straighten out.
It only took Tang Biyue twenty years to reach the peak of the Nascent Soul Realm, but she’s already been in the Rebirth Realm for over two hundred years.
As a mythical beast, my lifespan is much longer than humans and I reached the rebirth realm after 100 years of cultivation.
Even so, it took me more than four thousand years to finally reach the realm of transcendence.
That’s the talent curve, when you reach the end of it, your cultivation slows down, the annual breakthroughs start to take decades, centuries or even millennia."
Qingyi listened attentively, a doubt soon rising in his chest. "Thank you for your teachings, guardian. But why are you telling me this?"
"Because your talent curve seems to have no end, it’s not slowing down. On the contrary, it’s getting faster." Yanxiao replied. "You’re an anomaly that I’ve only seen a few times in my life."
"Few times? Has the guardian ever seen other people like me?" Qingyi tilted her face slightly.
"A few, sometimes every few millennia, sometimes every few tens of millennia." Yanxiao walked around Qingyi, his claws tapping the ground.

"They have two futures: either they die early, or they ascend to the immortal heaven. I’ve never seen any of them who have stayed on this plane for more than a decade. Either they ascend before they’re thirty, or they die before they’re thirty."
Yanxiao brought his face close to Qingyi’s, sniffing him.
A breath of boiling air left his huge nostrils and made Qingyi’s long hair flutter.
He wondered which of these Qingyi was?
Unfortunately, that wasn’t what Yanxiao was there for.
Looking into the future of someone like Qingyi was dangerous, the heavens didn’t like such things and no divination master would have the courage to accept such a request.
"Qingyi." Yanxiao forced even more seriousness into his voice.
It was time to deal with the matter for which he had called Qingyi.
"I put the sect leader under house arrest, do you know why I did that?"
"I heard rumors that she was controlled by a being from the immortal heaven, her original soul erased and exchanged for a fragment of that being’s soul."
"Oh... You’re better informed than I thought." Yanxiao sniffed Qingyi once more.
"You’ve never had any contact with her, right?" Yanxiao asked.
"No, and honestly, I don’t understand where the guardian is going with this." Qingyi shook his head.
"If you’re lying to me, the consequences will be severe." For the first time since Qingyi and Yanxiao had met, the huge flaming tiger unleashed its aura on the young man.
The world around them seemed to fall silent, Yanxiao’s Qi so overwhelming that space seemed about to collapse, unable to withstand so much power.
"Tell me, why is there a smell so similar to hers on you? Did she give you the means to advance so quickly?"

For 3,000 years, they had been best friends, until, on that day, she changed.
